text:
(* Syntax conventions
   <nl> is significant: component declarations, groups, properties, and closing delimiters are line-oriented.
   [ X ] means optional X. { X } means zero or more X. A | B means either A or B.
*)

(* app *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: app-direct-property
text:
<app-direct-property> ::= "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "alias" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "version" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "standard" | "library" | "boilerplate" | "theme" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "group" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: SELECT LIST *)

title: app-gen-ai-property
text:
<app-gen-ai-property> ::= "service" ":" <ws> <reference> (* type: COMPONENT *)
  | "aiConsentMessage" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when service is set; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "requestHandlerProcedure" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "responseHandlerProcedure" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)

title: app-logo-property
text:
<app-logo-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "image" | "text" | "imageAndText" | "custom" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "imageUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (I, IT); type: TEXT *)
  | "text" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (T, IT); type: TEXT *)
  | "customHtml" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = C; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: app-navigation-menu-property
text:
<app-navigation-menu-property> ::= "listTemplate" ":" <ws> <reference> (* type: COMPONENT *)
  | "templateOptions" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when listTemplate is set; type: TEMPLATE OPTIONS *)
  | "listPosition" ":" <ws> ( "top" | "side" ) (* required; applies when listTemplate is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when listTemplate is set; type: COMPONENT *)

title: app-navigation-bar-property
text:
<app-navigation-bar-property> ::= "implementation" ":" <ws> ( "classic" | "list" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when implementation = LIST; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "listTemplate" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when implementation = LIST; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "templateOptions" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when listTemplate is set; type: TEMPLATE OPTIONS *)

title: app-user-interface-property
text:
<app-user-interface-property> ::= "currentTheme" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "globalPage" ":" <ws> <number> (* type: PAGE *)
  | "usersCanChooseThemeStyle" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "addBuiltWithApexToFooter" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "autoDismissSuccessMessages" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)

title: app-app-format-masks-property
text:
<app-app-format-masks-property> ::= "date" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "dateTime" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "timestamp" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "timestampTimeZone" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COMBOBOX *)

title: app-java-script-property
text:
<app-java-script-property> ::= "fileUrls" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* type: FILE URLS JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "includeLegacyJavascript" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* type: CHECKBOXES *)
  | "includeJqueryMigrate" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)

title: app-authentication-property
text:
<app-authentication-property> ::= "scheme" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "configProcedureName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "publicUser" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)

title: app-authorization-property
text:
<app-authorization-property> ::= "scheme" ":" <ws> <reference> (* type: COMPONENT *)
  | "runOnPublicPages" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when scheme != MUST_NOT_BE_PUBLIC_USER; type: YES NO *)
  | "runOnBackgroundJob" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when scheme is set; type: YES NO *)
  | "sourceForRoleOrGroupSchemes" ":" <ws> ( "accessControlUserRoleAssignments" | "authenticationScheme" | "customCode" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: app-security-property
text:
<app-security-property> ::= "deepLinking" ":" <ws> ( "true" | "false" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "enableDictation" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "browserCache" ":" <ws> ( "true" | "false" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "embedInFrames" ":" <ws> ( "deny" | "allowSameOrigin" | "allow" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "referrerPolicy" ":" <ws> ( "noReferrer" | "noReferrerWhenDowngrade" | "origin" | "originWhenCrossOrigin" | "sameOrigin" | "strictOrigin" | "strictOriginWhenCrossOrigin" | "unsafeUrl" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "htmlEscapingMode" ":" <ws> ( "basic" | "extended" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "httpResponseHeaders" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "runtimeApiUsage" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* type: CHECKBOXES *)

title: app-session-state-protection-property
text:
<app-session-state-protection-property> ::= "enabled" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "allowUrlsCreatedAfter" ":" <ws> <datetime-value> (* type: DATETIME *)
  | "bookmarkHashFunction" ":" <ws> ( "sha1" | "sha2-256bit" | "sha2-384bit" | "sha2-512bit" | "md5" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "checksumSalt" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: HIDDEN *)
  | "acceptPre202UrlChecksums" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)

title: app-session-management-property
text:
<app-session-management-property> ::= "rejoinSessions" ":" <ws> ( "false" | "publicSessions" | "allSessions" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sessionStateCommits" ":" <ws> ( "immediate" | "endOfRequest" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "maxSessionLength" ":" <ws> <number> (* type: INTEGER *)
  | "sessionTimeoutUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "maxSessionIdleTime" ":" <ws> <number> (* type: INTEGER *)
  | "sessionIdleTimeoutUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "sessionTimeoutWarning" ":" <ws> <number> (* type: INTEGER *)

title: app-database-session-property
text:
<app-database-session-property> ::= "parsingSchema" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: OWNER *)
  | "mleEnvironment" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "initPlsqlCode" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: PLSQL *)
  | "cleanupPlsqlCode" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: PLSQL *)

title: app-globalization-property
text:
<app-globalization-property> ::= "primaryLanguage" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: SELECT LIST; large enum list omitted *)
  | "documentDirection" ":" <ws> ( "leftToRight" | "rightToLeft" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "translationMethod" ":" <ws> ( "translationApps" | "textMessages" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "languageDerivedFrom" ":" <ws> ( "notTranslated" | "appPrimaryLanguage" | "browserPreference" | "appPreference" | "itemPreference" | "session" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "autoTimeZone" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "autoCsvEncoding" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)

title: app-progressive-web-app-property
text:
<app-progressive-web-app-property> ::= "enable" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "installable" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when enable = Y; type: YES NO *)
  | "display" ":" <ws> ( "fullscreen" | "standalone" | "minimalUI" | "browser" ) (* required; applies when installable = Y; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "screenOrientation" ":" <ws> ( "any" | "natural" | "landscape" | "landscapePrimary" | "landscapeSecondary" | "portrait" | "portraitPrimary" | "portraitSecondary" ) (* required; applies when installable = Y; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "themeColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when installable = Y; type: COLOR *)
  | "backgroundColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when installable = Y; type: COLOR *)
  | "appDescription" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when installable = Y; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "appShortName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when enable = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "customManifest" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when installable = Y; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "manifestIconUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when enable = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "enablePushNotifications" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when enable = Y; type: YES NO *)
  | "pushNotificationsCredentials" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when enablePushNotifications = Y; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "contactEmail" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when enablePushNotifications = Y; type: TEXT *)

title: app-custom-service-worker-property
text:
<app-custom-service-worker-property> ::= "mode" ":" <ws> ( "default" | "custom" | "url" ) (* required; applies when enable = Y; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "url" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when mode = URL; type: TEXT *)
  | "functionVariableDeclarationMode" ":" <ws> ( "default" | "hook" ) (* required; applies when mode = CUSTOM; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "functionVariableDeclaration" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when functionVariableDeclarationMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "installMode" ":" <ws> ( "default" | "custom" | "hook" ) (* required; applies when mode = CUSTOM; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "eventInstall" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when installMode = CUSTOM; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "eventInstallBefore" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when installMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "eventInstallAfter" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when installMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "activateMode" ":" <ws> ( "default" | "custom" | "hook" ) (* required; applies when mode = CUSTOM; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "eventActivate" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when activateMode = CUSTOM; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "eventActivateBefore" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when activateMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "eventActivateAfter" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when activateMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "fetchMode" ":" <ws> ( "default" | "custom" | "hook" ) (* required; applies when mode = CUSTOM; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "eventFetch" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when fetchMode = CUSTOM; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "eventFetchBefore" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when fetchMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "eventFetchCacheDefinition" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when fetchMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "eventFetchCacheResponse" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when fetchMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "eventFetchNetworkResponseSuccess" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when fetchMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "eventFetchNetworkResponseError" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when fetchMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "eventFetchOfflinePage" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when fetchMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "eventFetchNetworkFallback" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when fetchMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "syncMode" ":" <ws> ( "default" | "custom" ) (* required; applies when mode = CUSTOM; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "eventSync" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when syncMode = CUSTOM; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "pushMode" ":" <ws> ( "default" | "custom" | "hook" ) (* required; applies when mode = CUSTOM; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "eventPush" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when pushMode = CUSTOM; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "eventPushBefore" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when pushMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "eventPushAfter" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when pushMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "notificationClickMode" ":" <ws> ( "default" | "custom" | "hook" ) (* required; applies when mode = CUSTOM; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "eventNotificationClick" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when notificationClickMode = CUSTOM; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "evenNotificationClickBefore" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when notificationClickMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "evenNotificationClickAfter" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when notificationClickMode = HOOK; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "notificationCloseMode" ":" <ws> ( "default" | "custom" | "hook" ) (* required; applies when mode = CUSTOM; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "evenNotificationClose" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when notificationCloseMode = CUSTOM; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "canMakePaymentMode" ":" <ws> ( "default" | "custom" ) (* required; applies when mode = CUSTOM; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "evenCanMakePayment" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when canMakePaymentMode = CUSTOM; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "paymentRequestMode" ":" <ws> ( "default" | "custom" ) (* required; applies when mode = CUSTOM; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "evenPaymentRequest" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when paymentRequestMode = CUSTOM; type: JAVASCRIPT *)

title: app-row-search-property
text:
<app-row-search-property> ::= "tokenize" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "textQueryFunction" ":" <ws> ( "searchEngine" | "expertSearch" | "custom" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "customFunctionName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when textQueryFunction = CUSTOM; type: TEXT *)

title: app-report-printing-property
text:
<app-report-printing-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "native" | "remote" | "useInstanceSettings" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "remotePrintServer" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = REMOTE; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "credentials" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when type = REMOTE; type: COMPONENT *)

title: app-file-storage-property
text:
<app-file-storage-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "database" | "objectStorage" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fileServer" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = OBJECT_STORE; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: app-error-handling-property
text:
<app-error-handling-property> ::= "defaultDisplayLocation" ":" <ws> ( "inlineWithFieldAndInNotification" | "inlineWithField" | "inlineInNotification" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "errorHandlingFunctionName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)

title: app-runtime-property
text:
<app-runtime-property> ::= "friendlyUrls" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "allowFeedback" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "logging" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "debugging" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "compatibilityMode" ":" <ws> ( "26.1" | "24.2" | "21.2" | "19.2-20.1-20.2-21.1" | "19.1" | "5.1-18.1-18.2" | "5.0" | "4.2" | "4.1" | "4.0" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "accessibleReadOnlyItems" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)

title: app-proxy-property
text:
<app-proxy-property> ::= "proxyServer" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "noProxyDomains" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when proxyServer is set; type: TEXT *)

title: app-availability-property
text:
<app-availability-property> ::= "status" ":" <ws> ( "available" | "availableWithDevToolbar" | "availableDevsOnly" | "restricted" | "unavailable" | "unavailableStatusShownWithPlsql" | "unavailableRedirectToUrl" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "message" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when status in (UNAVAILABLE, UNAVAILABLE_PLSQL, UNAVAILABLE_URL); type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "restrictUserList" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* required; applies when status = RESTRICTED_ACCESS; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "globalNotificationMessage" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "buildStatus" ":" <ws> ( "runOnly" | "runAndBuild" ) (* required; applies when type in (STANDARD, PATTERN); type: SELECT LIST *)

title: app-advanced-property
text:
<app-advanced-property> ::= "exactSubstitutions" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "passEcid" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "modernizeApp" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "emailFromAddress" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "copyrightBanner" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "faviconHtml" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "maxBackgroundPageProcessJobs" ":" <ws> <number> (* type: INTEGER *)
  | "vacationRuleProcedureName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "mediaType" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "opentelemetryProductFamily" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "appBuilderIconName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)

(* page *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: page-direct-property
text:
<page-direct-property> ::= "page" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; type: NUMBER *)
  | "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "alias" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: TEXT *)
  | "title" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: TEXT *)
  | "pageGroup" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when type in (STANDARD, PATTERN); type: COMPONENT *)

title: page-appearance-property
text:
<page-appearance-property> ::= "pageMode" ":" <ws> ( "normal" | "modalDialog" | "nonModalDialog" ) (* required; applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "pageTemplate" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when pageMode = NORMAL and globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "dialogTemplate" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when pageMode in (MODAL, NON_MODAL); type: COMPONENT *)
  | "templateOptions" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* type: TEMPLATE OPTIONS *)
  | "cssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "mediaType" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: TEXT *)

title: page-dialog-property
text:
<page-dialog-property> ::= "width" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when pageMode in (MODAL, NON_MODAL); type: TEXT *)
  | "height" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when pageMode in (MODAL, NON_MODAL); type: TEXT *)
  | "maxWidth" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when pageMode in (MODAL, NON_MODAL); type: TEXT *)
  | "attributes" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when pageMode in (MODAL, NON_MODAL); type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "cssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when pageMode in (MODAL, NON_MODAL); type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "chained" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when pageMode in (MODAL, NON_MODAL); type: YES NO *)
  | "resizable" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when pageMode in (MODAL, NON_MODAL); type: YES NO *)

title: page-navigation-menu-property
text:
<page-navigation-menu-property> ::= "overrideUserInterfaceLevel" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when currentTheme supports HAS_LIST_NAVIGATION and globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: YES NO *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when overrideUserInterfaceLevel = Y; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "listPosition" ":" <ws> ( "top" | "side" ) (* required; applies when list is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "listTemplate" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when list is set; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "templateOptions" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when list is set; type: TEMPLATE OPTIONS *)

title: page-navigation-property
text:
<page-navigation-property> ::= "cursorFocus" ":" <ws> ( "firstItemOnPage" | "doNotFocusCursor" ) (* required; applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "warnOnUnsavedChanges" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: YES NO *)

title: page-java-script-property
text:
<page-java-script-property> ::= "fileUrls" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: FILE URLS JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "functionAndGlobalVariableDeclaration" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "executeWhenPageLoads" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "includeStandardJavaScriptAndCss" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: YES NO *)

title: page-css-property
text:
<page-css-property> ::= "fileUrls" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: FILE URLS CSS *)
  | "inline" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: CSS *)

title: page-html-header-property
text:
<page-html-header-property> ::= "htmlHeader" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: HTML *)
  | "pageHtmlBodyAttribute" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: page-header-and-footer-property
text:
<page-header-and-footer-property> ::= "headerText" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: HTML *)
  | "bodyHeader" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: HTML *)
  | "footerText" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: HTML *)

title: page-read-only-property
text:
<page-read-only-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: SELECT LIST; large enum list omitted *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS); type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "page" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_EQUALS_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_EQUAL_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "pages" ":" <ws> <array-of-number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_IN_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_IN_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)

  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST, VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_NOT_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST); type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (DISPLAY_COND_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_NOT_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_EQUAL_COND_TEXT, DISP_COND_NOT_EQUAL_COND_TEXT); type: TEXT *)

title: page-security-property
text:
<page-security-property> ::= "authorizationScheme" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "authentication" ":" <ws> ( "required" | "public" ) (* required; applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "deepLinking" ":" <ws> ( "true" | "false" ) (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "pageAccessProtection" ":" <ws> ( "unrestricted" | "argumentsMustHaveChecksum" | "noArgumentsSupported" | "noUrlAccess" ) (* required; applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "formAutoComplete" ":" <ws> ( "true" | "false" ) (* required; applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "browserCache" ":" <ws> ( "true" | "false" ) (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: page-session-management-property
text: <page-session-management-property> ::= "rejoinSessions" ":" <ws> ( "false" | "publicSessions" | "allSessions" ) (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: page-advanced-property
text:
<page-advanced-property> ::= "enableMetaTags" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when authentication = Y; type: YES NO *)
  | "enableDuplicatePageSubmissions" ":" <ws> ( "false" | "true" ) (* required; applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: SELECT LIST *)

  | "duplicateSubmissionUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when enableDuplicatePageSubmissions = N; type: TEXT *)

title: page-server-cache-property
text:
<page-server-cache-property> ::= "caching" ":" <ws> ( "false" | "true" | "cacheByUser" | "cacheBySession" ) (* required; applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: SELECT LIST *)

  | "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when caching != NOCACHE; type: SELECT LIST; large enum list omitted *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS); type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)

  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "page" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_EQUALS_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_EQUAL_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "pages" ":" <ws> <array-of-number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_IN_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_IN_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "text" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST, VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_NOT_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST); type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (DISPLAY_COND_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_NOT_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_EQUAL_COND_TEXT, DISP_COND_NOT_EQUAL_COND_TEXT); type: TEXT *)

title: page-error-handling-property
text:
<page-error-handling-property> ::= "inLineErrorNotificationText" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when globalPage != #COMPONENT_PAGE_ID#; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: branch-a-execution-property
text:
<branch-a-execution-property> ::= "sequence" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; type: NUMBER *)
  | "point" ":" <ws> ( "beforeHeader" | "afterSubmit" | "validating" | "processing" | "afterProcessing" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: branch-a-behavior-property
text:
<branch-a-behavior-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "pageOrUrl" | "urlIdentifiedByItem" | "functionReturningUrl" | "page" | "pageIdentifiedByItem" | "functionReturningPage" | "plsqlProcedure" | "pageProcessing" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "target" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when type = REDIRECT_URL; type: LINK_BRANCH *)
  | "saveStateBeforeBranching" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type = REDIRECT_URL; type: YES NO *)
  | "pageNumber" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when type in (BRANCH_TO_STEP, BRANCH_TO_PAGE_ACCEPT); type: PAGE *)
  | "request" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = BRANCH_TO_PAGE_ACCEPT; type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (BRANCH_TO_PAGE_IDENT_BY_ITEM, BRANCH_TO_URL_IDENT_BY_ITEM); type: ITEM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type in (BRANCH_TO_FUNCTION_RETURNING_PAGE, BRANCH_TO_FUNCTION_RETURNING_URL); type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language in (PLSQL) *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language in (JAVASCRIPT) *)
  | "plsqlCode" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = PLSQL; type: PLSQL *)

title: branch-a-server-side-condition-property
text:
<branch-a-server-side-condition-property> ::= "whenButtonPressed" ":" <ws> <reference> (* type: COMPONENT *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: SELECT LIST; large enum list omitted *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS); type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "page" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_EQUALS_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_EQUAL_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "pages" ":" <ws> <array-of-number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_IN_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_IN_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "text" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST, VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_NOT_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST); type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (DISPLAY_COND_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_NOT_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_EQUAL_COND_TEXT, DISP_COND_NOT_EQUAL_COND_TEXT); type: TEXT *)

title: branch-a-comments-property
text:
<branch-a-comments-property> ::= "comments" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)

(* button *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: button-direct-property
text:
<button-direct-property> ::= "buttonName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "label" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)

title: button-layout-property
text:
<button-layout-property> ::= "sequence" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; type: NUMBER *)
  | "region" ":" <ws> <reference> (* type: COMPONENT *)
  | "slot" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "startNewLayout" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "startNewRow" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when startNewLayout = N or not set; type: YES NO *)
  | "rowCssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "column" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "newColumn" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when startNewRow = N or not set; type: YES NO *)
  | "columnSpan" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "rowSpan" ":" <ws> <number> (* type: NUMBER *)
  | "columnCssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "columnAttributes" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "horizontalAlignment" ":" <ws> ( "left" | "right" ) (* required; applies when slot in (TOP, TOP_AND_BOTTOM, ABOVE_BOX, BELOW_BOX, BOTTOM); type: PILL BUTTONS *)
  | "alignment" ":" <ws> ( "center" | "centerBottom" | "centerCenter" | "centerTop" | "left" | "leftBottom" | "leftCenter" | "leftTop" | "right" | "rightBottom" | "rightCenter" | "rightTop" ) (* required; applies when slot = BODY; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: button-appearance-property
text:
<button-appearance-property> ::= "buttonTemplate" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "hot" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "showAsDisabled" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when buttonTemplate supports IS_DISABLED; type: YES NO *)
  | "templateOptions" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* type: TEMPLATE OPTIONS *)
  | "cssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "icon" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: ICON *)

title: button-behavior-property
text:
<button-behavior-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "action" ":" <ws> ( "submitPage" | "triggerAction" | "redirectThisApp" | "redirectOtherApp" | "redirectUrl" | "definedByDynamicAction" | "resetPage" | "nextPage" | "previousPage" ) (* required; applies when type = STANDARD; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "target" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when action = REDIRECT_PAGE; type: LINK_IN_APP *)
  | "target" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when action = REDIRECT_APP; type: LINK_IN_DIFF_APP *)
  | "targetUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when action = REDIRECT_URL; type: TEXT *)
  | "executeValidations" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when action in (SUBMIT, REDIRECT_URL, DEFINED_BY_DA, DEFINED_BY_DA_ACTION); type: YES NO *)
  | "showProcessing" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when action = SUBMIT; type: YES NO *)
  | "warnOnUnsavedChanges" ":" <ws> ( "doNotCheck" ) (* applies when action not in (DEFINED_BY_DA, DEFINED_BY_DA_ACTION); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "databaseAction" ":" <ws> ( "insert" | "update" | "delete" ) (* applies when type = STANDARD; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "requiresConfirmation" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type = STANDARD; type: YES NO *)

title: button-confirmation-property
text:
<button-confirmation-property> ::= "message" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when requiresConfirmation = Y; type: HTML *)
  | "style" ":" <ws> ( "information" | "warning" | "danger" | "success" ) (* applies when requiresConfirmation = Y; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: button-advanced-property
text:

  | "staticId" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: STATIC ID *)
  | "customAttributes" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "preText" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: HTML *)
  | "postText" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: HTML *)

  | "requestSource" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when requestSourceType is set; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: button-server-side-condition-property
text:
<button-server-side-condition-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: SELECT LIST; large enum list omitted *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS); type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)

  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "page" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_EQUALS_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_EQUAL_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "pages" ":" <ws> <array-of-number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_IN_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_IN_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "text" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST, VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_NOT_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST); type: TEXT *)

title: page-item-source-property
text:
<page-item-source-property> ::= "formRegion" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when type supports SOURCE; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "column" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when formRegion is set; type: COLUMN *)
  | "dataType" ":" <ws> ( "varchar2" | "number" | "date" | "timestamp" | "timestampWithTimeZone" | "timestampWithLocalTimeZone" | "intervalYearToMonth" | "intervalDayToSecond" | "clob" | "blob" | "boolean" | "rowid" | "bfile" | "sdoGeometry" ) (* required; applies when formRegion is set; type: SELECT LIST *)

  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = QUERY; type: SQL *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = QUERY_COLON; type: SQL *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = ITEM; type: ITEM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "databaseColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = DB_COLUMN; type: TEXT *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = PREFERENCE; type: TEXT *)
  | "used" ":" <ws> ( "always" | "onlyWhenSessionStateIsNull" ) (* required; applies when type supports SOURCE and formRegion is not set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "postCalculationComputation" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type supports SOURCE and formRegion is not set *)

title: page-item-default-property
text:
<page-item-default-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "static" | "item" | "sqlQuerySingleValue" | "sqlQueryMultipleValues" | "expression" | "functionBody" | "sequence" ) (* applies when type supports SOURCE; type: SELECT LIST *)

  | "sequence" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = SEQUENCE; type: TEXT *)

title: page-item-session-state-property

title: process-direct-property
text:
<process-direct-property> ::= "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)

<region-body-property> ::= "advancedFormatting" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "column" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when advancedFormatting = N; type: COLUMN *)
  | "htmlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when advancedFormatting = Y; type: HTML *)
  | "cssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when advancedFormatting = N; type: COMBOBOX *)

title: region-enable-users-to-property
text:
<region-enable-users-to-property> ::= "savePublicReport" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "savePublicReportAuthorization" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when savePublicReport = Y; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "flashback" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "defineChartView" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "download" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)

title: region-multi-series-chart-data-property
text:
<region-multi-series-chart-data-property> ::= "fillGapsInChartData" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type not in (stock, gantt, dial, funnel, pyramid, scatter, pie, donut); type: YES NO *)
  | "sortOrder" ":" <ws> ( "valueAsc" | "valueDesc" | "labelAsc" | "labelDesc" ) (* required; applies when fillGapsInChartData = Y; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "renderGapAsZero" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type in (line, lineWithArea, area, scatter, area, bar, line, lineWithArea, combo) and fillGapsInChartData = Y; type: YES NO *)

title: region-bounding-box-property
text:
<region-bounding-box-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "staticValues" | "sqlQuery" ) (* applies when options != INFINITE_MAP; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "geometryColumnDataType" ":" <ws> ( "sdoGeometry" | "longitudeLatitude" ) (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "minLongitude" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when geometryColumnDataType = LONLAT_COLUMNS; type: COLUMN *)
  | "minLatitude" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when geometryColumnDataType = LONLAT_COLUMNS; type: COLUMN *)
  | "maxLongitude" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when geometryColumnDataType = LONLAT_COLUMNS; type: COLUMN *)
  | "maxLatitude" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when geometryColumnDataType = LONLAT_COLUMNS; type: COLUMN *)
  | "geometryColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when geometryColumnDataType = SDO_GEOMETRY; type: COLUMN *)
  | "minLongitude" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = STATIC; type: TEXT *)
  | "minLatitude" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = STATIC; type: TEXT *)
  | "maxLongitude" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = STATIC; type: TEXT *)
  | "maxLatitude" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = STATIC; type: TEXT *)
  | "currentBoundsItem" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: ITEM *)

  | "fontColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: COLOR *)
  | "fontWeight" ":" <ws> ( "normal" | "bold" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "alignment" ":" <ws> ( "start" | "center" | "end" ) (* required; type: PILL BUTTONS *)
  | "fontSize" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; type: INTEGER *)
  | "fontColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: COLOR *)
  | "pageFooterText" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "alignment" ":" <ws> ( "start" | "center" | "end" ) (* required; type: PILL BUTTONS *)

  | "font" ":" <ws> ( "helvetica" | "times" | "courier" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontWeight" ":" <ws> ( "normal" | "bold" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontWeight" ":" <ws> ( "normal" | "bold" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)

  | "fontSize" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; type: INTEGER *)

  | "pageFooterText" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: region-secondary-body-property
text:
<region-secondary-body-property> ::= "advancedFormatting" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "column" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when advancedFormatting = N; type: COLUMN *)
  | "htmlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when advancedFormatting = Y; type: HTML *)
  | "cssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when advancedFormatting = N; type: COMBOBOX *)

title: region-settings-property
text:
<region-settings-property> ::= "timeAxisType" ":" <ws> ( "auto" | "disabled" | "enabled" | "mixedFrequency" | "skipGaps" ) (* applies when type in (area, bar, line, lineWithArea, stock, boxPlot, combo); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "zoomAndScroll" ":" <ws> ( "false" | "delayed" | "delayedScrollOnly" | "live" | "liveScrollOnly" ) (* required; applies when type not in (dial, pie, donut, gantt); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "zoomDirection" ":" <ws> ( "bothAxes" | "xAxis" | "yAxis" ) (* required; applies when type in (bubble, scatter) and zoomAndScroll != off; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "initialZooming" ":" <ws> ( "first" | "last" | "none" ) (* required; applies when type in (bar, line, area, lineWithArea, combo, stock) and zoomAndScroll != off; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "showHorizontalGrid" ":" <ws> ( "auto" | "true" | "false" ) (* required; applies when type = gantt; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "showVerticalGrid" ":" <ws> ( "auto" | "true" | "false" ) (* required; applies when type = gantt; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "showRowAxis" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type = gantt; type: YES NO *)
  | "axisPosition" ":" <ws> ( "top" | "bottom" ) (* required; applies when type = gantt; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "pieSelectionEffect" ":" <ws> ( "explode" | "highlightAndExplode" | "highlight" ) (* required; applies when type in (pie, donut); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "renderAs" ":" <ws> ( "area" | "bar" | "candlestick" | "line" | "lineWithArea" ) (* required; applies when type = stock; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: region-download-property
text:
<region-download-property> ::= "authorization" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when download = Y; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "formats" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when download = Y; type: CHECKBOXES *)
  | "sendAsEmail" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when download = Y; type: YES NO *)
  | "csvSeparator" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when formats = CSV; type: TEXT *)
  | "csvEnclosedBy" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when formats = CSV; type: TEXT *)
  | "csvExportEnabled" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "csvExportEnabled" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "filename" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when download = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "csvSeparator" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when csvExportEnabled = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "csvSeparator" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when csvExportEnabled = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "supplementalText" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when formats is set; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "csvEnclosedBy" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when csvExportEnabled = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "csvEnclosedBy" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when csvExportEnabled = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "linkText" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when csvExportEnabled = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "linkText" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when csvExportEnabled = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "filename" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when csvExportEnabled = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "filename" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when csvExportEnabled = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "supplementalText" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "supplementalText" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "authorization" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when download = Y; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "formats" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* required; applies when download = Y; type: CHECKBOXES *)
  | "sendAsEmail" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when download = Y; type: YES NO *)
  | "csvSeparator" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when formats = CSV; type: TEXT *)
  | "csvEnclosedBy" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when formats = CSV; type: TEXT *)
  | "filename" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when download = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "supplementalText" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when formats is set; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: region-component-advanced-property
text:
<region-component-advanced-property> ::= "stripHtml" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "stripHtml" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "sortNulls" ":" <ws> ( "first" | "last" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sortNulls" ":" <ws> ( "first" | "last" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "customSvgStyles" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "oracleTextIndexColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)
  | "emailFromAddress" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "initJavaScriptFunction" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "initJavaScriptFunction" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "initJavaScriptFunction" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "regionAlias" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "reportIdItem" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: ITEM *)
  | "oracleTextIndexColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)
  | "emailFromAddress" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "maxRowsPerPageInSelector" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when rowsPerPage = Y or rowsPerPageSelector = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "initJavaScriptFunction" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type supports INIT_JAVASCRIPT_CODE; type: JAVASCRIPT *)

title: region-single-row-view-property
text:
<region-single-row-view-property> ::= "excludeNullValues" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when linkColumn = Y; type: YES NO *)
  | "onlyDisplayedColumns" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when linkColumn = Y; type: YES NO *)

title: region-icon-and-badge-property
text:
<region-icon-and-badge-property> ::= "iconSource" ":" <ws> ( "initials" | "iconClass" | "iconClassColumn" | "imageUrl" | "imageBlobColumn" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "iconColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when iconSource in (INITIALS, DYNAMIC_CLASS); type: COLUMN *)
  | "imageColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when iconSource = BLOB; type: COLUMN *)
  | "imageUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when iconSource = URL; type: TEXT *)
  | "iconCssClasses" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when iconSource in (INITIALS, DYNAMIC_CLASS, BLOB, URL); type: ICON *)
  | "iconCssClasses" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when iconSource = STATIC_CLASS; type: ICON *)
  | "iconPosition" ":" <ws> ( "top" | "start" | "end" ) (* required; applies when iconSource is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "iconDescription" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when iconSource is set; type: TEXT *)
  | "badgeColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)
  | "badgeLabel" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when badgeColumn is set; type: TEXT *)
  | "badgeCssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when badgeColumn is set; type: COMBOBOX *)

title: region-heading-property
text:
<region-heading-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "columnNames" | "columnNamesInitcap" | "customHeadings" | "plsqlFunctionBody" | "none" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "columnNames" | "columnNamesInitcap" | "customHeadings" | "plsqlFunctionBody" | "none" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY_RETURNING_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY_RETURNING_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST *)
  | "fixedTo" ":" <ws> ( "none" | "region" | "page" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fixedReportHeight" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when fixedTo = REGION; type: INTEGER *)
  | "fixedTo" ":" <ws> ( "none" | "region" | "page" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "maxReportHeight" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when fixedTo = REGION; type: INTEGER *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "columnNames" | "columnNamesInitcap" | "customHeadings" | "plsqlFunctionBody" | "none" ) (* required; applies when type supports COLUMN_HEADING; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY_RETURNING_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST *)

title: region-icon-view-property
text:
<region-icon-view-property> ::= "show" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "custom" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when show = Y; type: YES NO *)
  | "customIcon" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when custom = Y; type: HTML *)
  | "iconType" ":" <ws> ( "imageInUrl" | "iconCssClasses" ) (* required; applies when custom = N; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "iconUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when custom = N and iconType = URL; type: REGION COLUMN *)
  | "icon" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when custom = N and iconType = CSS_CLASSES; type: REGION COLUMN *)
  | "iconAttributes" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when iconType = URL; type: TEXT *)
  | "linkTarget" ":" <ws> <value> (* applies when show = Y; type: LINK *)
  | "linkAttributes" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when linkTarget is set and custom = N; type: TEXT *)
  | "labelColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when custom = N; type: REGION COLUMN *)
  | "show" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "custom" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when show = Y; type: YES NO *)
  | "columnsPerRow" ":" <ws> ( "1" | "2" | "3" | "4" | "5" | "6" | "7" | "8" | "9" ) (* required; applies when show = Y; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "linkColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when custom = N; type: COLUMN *)
  | "imageSourceColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when custom = N; type: COLUMN *)
  | "labelColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when custom = N; type: COLUMN *)
  | "imageAttributes" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when custom = N; type: TEXT *)
  | "htmlAltText" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when custom = N; type: TEXT *)
  | "htmlTitleText" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when custom = N; type: TEXT *)
  | "customLink" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when custom = Y; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: region-overview-property
text:
<region-overview-property> ::= "show" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type in (area, bar, line, stock, boxPlot, lineWithArea, combo) and zoomAndScroll != off; type: YES NO *)
  | "height" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when show = on; type: TEXT *)

title: region-legend-property
text:
<region-legend-property> ::= "show" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "title" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when show = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "position" ":" <ws> ( "start" | "end" | "selector" ) (* required; applies when show = Y; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "selector" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when position = SELECTOR; type: TEXT *)
  | "cssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when show = Y; type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "show" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type not in (dial, stock, gantt); type: YES NO *)
  | "title" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when show = on and type not in (funnel, pyramid, gantt); type: TEXT *)
  | "position" ":" <ws> ( "auto" | "start" | "end" | "top" | "bottom" ) (* required; applies when show = on and type not in (funnel, pyramid, gantt); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "hideAndShowBehavior" ":" <ws> ( "none" | "rescale" | "noRescaling" ) (* required; applies when show = on; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontFamily" ":" <ws> ( "arial" | "arialBlack" | "bookman" | "comicSansMs" | "courier" | "courierNew" | "garamond" | "georgia" | "helvetica" | "impact" | "palatino" | "times" | "timesNewRoman" | "trebuchetMs" | "verdana" ) (* applies when show = on; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontStyle" ":" <ws> ( "normal" | "italic" | "oblique" ) (* applies when show = on; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontSize" ":" <ws> ( "8" | "10" | "12" | "14" | "16" | "18" | "20" | "22" ) (* applies when show = on; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when show = on; type: COLOR *)

title: region-printing-property
text:
<region-printing-property> ::= "enabled" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "enabled" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)

title: region-value-property
text:
<region-value-property> ::= "pieChartOtherThreshold" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when type in (pie, donut); type: NUMBER *)
  | "min" ":" <ws> <number> (* applies when type in (pie, donut); type: INTEGER *)
  | "show" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type = dial; type: YES NO *)
  | "valueType" ":" <ws> ( "number" | "percent" ) (* required; applies when type = dial; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "position" ":" <ws> ( "auto" | "center" | "insideIndicatorEdge" | "outsideIndicatorEdge" | "outsidePlotArea" | "withLabel" ) (* required; applies when type = dial and orientation != circular; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "format" ":" <ws> ( "dateShort" | "dateMedium" | "dateLong" | "dateFull" | "timeShort" | "timeMedium" | "timeLong" | "timeFull" | "datetimeShort" | "datetimeMedium" | "datetimeLong" | "datetimeFull" | "decimal" | "currency" | "percent" ) (* applies when type in (dial, funnel, pyramid, pie, donut); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "decimalPlaces" ":" <ws> <number> (* applies when type in (dial, funnel, pyramid, pie, donut) and format in (decimal, currency, percent); type: INTEGER *)
  | "currency" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (dial, funnel, pyramid, pie, donut) and format = currency; type: TEXT *)
  | "pattern" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (dial, funnel, pyramid, pie, donut) and format in (decimal, currency, percent); type: TEXT *)
  | "formatScaling" ":" <ws> ( "none" | "auto" | "thousand" | "million" | "billion" | "trillion" | "quadrillion" ) (* required; applies when type in (dial, funnel, pyramid, pie, donut); type: SELECT LIST *)

title: region-external-processing-property
text:
<region-external-processing-property> ::= "enabled" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "enabled" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "url" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when enabled = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "url" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when enabled = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "linkText" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when enabled = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "linkText" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when enabled = Y; type: TEXT *)

title: region-gen-ai-property
text:
<region-gen-ai-property> ::= "naturalLanguageSupport" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "defaultSearchMode" ":" <ws> ( "searchModeRow" | "searchModeAI" ) (* required; applies when naturalLanguageSupport = Y; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "reportContext" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when naturalLanguageSupport = Y; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "enabled" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type supports AI_ENABLED; type: YES NO *)
  | "agent" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when type supports AI_ENABLED_ALWAYS, AI_ENABLED and enabled = Y or not set; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "service" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when agent is not set; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "systemPrompt" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type supports AI_SYSTEM_PROMPT and agent is not set; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "welcomeMessage" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type supports AI_UI and agent is not set; type: HTML *)

title: region-media-property
text:
<region-media-property> ::= "advancedFormatting" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "htmlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when advancedFormatting = Y; type: HTML *)
  | "source" ":" <ws> ( "imageUrl" | "urlColumn" | "blobColumn" ) (* applies when advancedFormatting = N; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "url" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when source = STATIC_URL; type: TEXT *)
  | "urlColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when source = DYNAMIC_URL; type: COLUMN *)
  | "blobColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when source = BLOB; type: COLUMN *)
  | "position" ":" <ws> ( "first" | "body" | "background" ) (* required; applies when source is set or not set and htmlExpression is set or not set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "appearance" ":" <ws> ( "square" | "widescreen" ) (* applies when source is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sizing" ":" <ws> ( "fit" | "cover" ) (* required; applies when source is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "cssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "imageDescription" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when source is set; type: TEXT *)

title: region-attributes-property
text:
<region-attributes-property> ::= "messagesPosition" ":" <ws> ( "above" | "below" | "selector" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "messageSelector" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when messagesPosition = SELECTOR; type: TEXT *)
  | "unitSystem" ":" <ws> ( "metric" | "imperial" | "deriveFromItem" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "unitSystemItem" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when unitSystem = ITEM; type: ITEM *)
  | "copyrightNotice" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: HTML *)

title: region-search-bar-property
text:
<region-search-bar-property> ::= "includeSearchBar" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "searchField" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when includeSearchBar = Y; type: YES NO *)

<trigger-action-a-execution-property> ::= "sequence" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; type: NUMBER *)
  | "stopExecutionOnError" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when action supports STOP_EXECUTION_ON_ERROR; type: YES NO *)
  | "waitForResult" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when action supports WAIT_FOR_RESULT; type: YES NO *)

title: trigger-action-a-client-side-condition-property
text:
<trigger-action-a-client-side-condition-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "item=value" | "item!=value" | "item>value" | "item>=value" | "item<value" | "item<=value" | "itemIsNull" | "itemIsNotNull" | "itemIsInList" | "itemIsNotInList" | "jsExpression" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (EQUALS, NOT_EQUALS, GREATER_THAN, GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL, LESS_THAN, LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL, NULL, NOT_NULL, IN_LIST, NOT_IN_LIST); type: ITEM *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (EQUALS, NOT_EQUALS, GREATER_THAN, GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL, LESS_THAN, LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL); type: TEXT *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (IN_LIST, NOT_IN_LIST); type: TEXT *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = JAVASCRIPT_EXPRESSION; type: JAVASCRIPT *)

title: trigger-action-a-server-side-condition-property
text:
<trigger-action-a-server-side-condition-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: SELECT LIST; large enum list omitted *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS); type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "page" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_EQUALS_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_EQUAL_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "pages" ":" <ws> <array-of-number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_IN_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_IN_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "text" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST, VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_NOT_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST); type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (DISPLAY_COND_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_NOT_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_EQUAL_COND_TEXT, DISP_COND_NOT_EQUAL_COND_TEXT); type: TEXT *)

title: trigger-action-a-advanced-property
text:
<trigger-action-a-advanced-property> ::= "staticId" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: STATIC ID *)
  | "initJavaScriptFunction" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when action supports INIT_JAVASCRIPT_CODE; type: JAVASCRIPT *)

(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: axis-direct-property
text:
<axis-direct-property> ::= "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "showAxis" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "title" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)

title: axis-time-scale-property
text: <axis-time-scale-property> ::= "scale" ":" <ws> ( "seconds" | "minutes" | "hours" | "days" | "weeks" | "months" | "quarters" | "years" ) (* required; applies when name in (major, minor); type: SELECT LIST *)

title: axis-zoom-scale-property
text:
<axis-zoom-scale-property> ::= "seconds" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when name in (major, minor); type: YES NO *)
  | "minutes" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when name in (major, minor); type: YES NO *)
  | "hours" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when name in (major, minor); type: YES NO *)
  | "days" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when name in (major, minor); type: YES NO *)
  | "weeks" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when name in (major, minor); type: YES NO *)
  | "months" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when name in (major, minor); type: YES NO *)
  | "quarters" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when name in (major, minor); type: YES NO *)
  | "years" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when name in (major, minor); type: YES NO *)

title: axis-title-property
text:
<axis-title-property> ::= "fontFamily" ":" <ws> ( "arial" | "arialBlack" | "bookman" | "comicSansMs" | "courier" | "courierNew" | "garamond" | "georgia" | "helvetica" | "impact" | "palatino" | "times" | "timesNewRoman" | "trebuchetMs" | "verdana" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontStyle" ":" <ws> ( "normal" | "italic" | "oblique" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontSize" ":" <ws> ( "8" | "10" | "12" | "14" | "16" | "18" | "20" | "22" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLOR *)

title: axis-value-property
text:
<axis-value-property> ::= "min" ":" <ws> <number> (* type: NUMBER *)
  | "max" ":" <ws> <number> (* type: NUMBER *)
  | "format" ":" <ws> ( "dateShort" | "dateMedium" | "dateLong" | "dateFull" | "timeShort" | "timeMedium" | "timeLong" | "timeFull" | "datetimeShort" | "datetimeMedium" | "datetimeLong" | "datetimeFull" | "decimal" | "currency" | "percent" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "decimalPlaces" ":" <ws> <number> (* type: INTEGER *)
  | "currency" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "pattern" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "formatScaling" ":" <ws> ( "none" | "auto" | "thousand" | "million" | "billion" | "trillion" | "quadrillion" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "baselineScaling" ":" <ws> ( "min" | "zero" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "scale" ":" <ws> ( "linear" | "log" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "step" ":" <ws> <number> (* type: NUMBER *)

title: axis-appearance-property
text: <axis-appearance-property> ::= "position" ":" <ws> ( "auto" | "start" | "end" | "top" | "bottom" ) (* required; applies when name not in (x, major, minor); type: SELECT LIST *)

title: axis-major-ticks-property
text:
<axis-major-ticks-property> ::= "show" ":" <ws> ( "auto" | "true" | "false" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "minStep" ":" <ws> <number> (* type: NUMBER *)

title: axis-minor-ticks-property
text:
<axis-minor-ticks-property> ::= "show" ":" <ws> ( "auto" | "true" | "false" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "step" ":" <ws> <number> (* type: NUMBER *)

title: axis-tick-label-property
text:
<axis-tick-label-property> ::= "show" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "rotation" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when show = on and name = x; type: YES NO *)
  | "position" ":" <ws> ( "outside" | "inside" ) (* required; applies when show = on and name = x; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontFamily" ":" <ws> ( "arial" | "arialBlack" | "bookman" | "comicSansMs" | "courier" | "courierNew" | "garamond" | "georgia" | "helvetica" | "impact" | "palatino" | "times" | "timesNewRoman" | "trebuchetMs" | "verdana" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontStyle" ":" <ws> ( "normal" | "italic" | "oblique" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontSize" ":" <ws> ( "8" | "10" | "12" | "14" | "16" | "18" | "20" | "22" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLOR *)

title: axis-dual-yaxes-property
text:
<axis-dual-yaxes-property> ::= "show" ":" <ws> ( "auto" | "true" | "false" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "splitterPosition" ":" <ws> <number> (* applies when show != off; type: NUMBER *)

title: axis-advanced-property
text:
<axis-advanced-property> ::= "staticId" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: STATIC ID *)

(* column *)

title: column-b-direct-property
text:
<column-b-direct-property> ::= "columnName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: SUPPORTED UI *)

title: column-b-row-selection-property
text:
<column-b-row-selection-property> ::= "enableMultiSelect" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type = NATIVE_ROW_SELECTOR; type: YES NO *)
  | "showSelectAll" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when enableMultiSelect = Y; type: YES NO *)
  | "hideControl" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type = NATIVE_ROW_SELECTOR; type: YES NO *)
  | "currentSelectionPageItem" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = NATIVE_ROW_SELECTOR; type: ITEM *)

title: column-b-heading-property
text:
<column-b-heading-property> ::= "heading" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type != NATIVE_ROW_SELECTOR; type: TEXT *)
  | "alternativeLabel" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type != NATIVE_ROW_SELECTOR; type: TEXT *)
  | "alignment" ":" <ws> ( "start" | "center" | "end" ) (* required; applies when type not in (NATIVE_HIDDEN_COLUMN, NATIVE_ROW_SELECTOR); type: PILL BUTTONS *)

title: column-b-single-row-view-property
text:
<column-b-single-row-view-property> ::= "useColumnHeading" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type not in (NATIVE_HIDDEN_COLUMN, NATIVE_ROW_SELECTOR); type: YES NO *)
  | "label" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when useColumnHeading = N; type: TEXT *)

title: column-b-lov-property
text: <column-b-lov-property> ::= "lov" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when type = NATIVE_PLAIN_LOV; type: COMPONENT *)

title: column-b-layout-property
text:
<column-b-layout-property> ::= "sequence" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when type != NATIVE_ROW_SELECTOR; type: NUMBER *)
  | "columnAlignment" ":" <ws> ( "start" | "center" | "end" ) (* required; applies when type not in (NATIVE_HIDDEN_COLUMN, NATIVE_ROW_SELECTOR); type: PILL BUTTONS *)
  | "group" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when type not in (NATIVE_HIDDEN_COLUMN, NATIVE_ROW_SELECTOR); type: COMPONENT *)

title: column-b-accessibility-property
text:
<column-b-accessibility-property> ::= "valueIdentifiesRow" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type not in (NATIVE_HIDDEN_COLUMN, NATIVE_PCT_GRAPH, NATIVE_RICH_TEXT, NATIVE_ROW_SELECTOR); type: YES NO *)
  | "imageDescription" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = NATIVE_IMAGE; type: TEXT *)

title: column-b-settings-property
text: <column-b-settings-property> ::= "format" ":" <ws> ( "html" | "markdown" ) (* required; applies when type = NATIVE_RICH_TEXT; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: column-b-appearance-property
text:
<column-b-appearance-property> ::= "cssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when type != NATIVE_HIDDEN_COLUMN; type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "formatMask" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (NATIVE_PLAIN, NATIVE_LINK, NATIVE_STRIP_HTML); type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "backgroundColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = NATIVE_PCT_GRAPH; type: COLOR *)
  | "foregroundColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = NATIVE_PCT_GRAPH; type: COLOR *)
  | "barWidth" ":" <ws> <number> (* applies when type = NATIVE_PCT_GRAPH; type: INTEGER *)
  | "viewFileAs" ":" <ws> ( "attachment" | "inline" ) (* required; applies when type = NATIVE_DOWNLOAD; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "downloadText" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = NATIVE_DOWNLOAD; type: TEXT *)

title: column-b-blob-attributes-property
text:
<column-b-blob-attributes-property> ::= "tableOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (NATIVE_IMAGE, NATIVE_DOWNLOAD); type: OWNER *)
  | "tableName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (NATIVE_IMAGE, NATIVE_DOWNLOAD); type: TABLE *)
  | "blobColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (NATIVE_IMAGE, NATIVE_DOWNLOAD); type: COLUMN *)
  | "primaryKeyColumn1" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (NATIVE_IMAGE, NATIVE_DOWNLOAD); type: COLUMN *)
  | "primaryKeyColumn2" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (NATIVE_IMAGE, NATIVE_DOWNLOAD); type: COLUMN *)
  | "mimeTypeColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (NATIVE_IMAGE, NATIVE_DOWNLOAD); type: COLUMN *)
  | "filenameColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (NATIVE_IMAGE, NATIVE_DOWNLOAD); type: COLUMN *)
  | "lastUpdatedColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (NATIVE_IMAGE, NATIVE_DOWNLOAD); type: COLUMN *)
  | "charSetColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = NATIVE_DOWNLOAD; type: COLUMN *)

title: column-b-link-property
text:
<column-b-link-property> ::= "target" ":" <ws> <value> (* applies when type in (NATIVE_PCT_GRAPH, NATIVE_PLAIN_LOV); type: LINK *)
  | "target" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when type = NATIVE_LINK; type: LINK *)
  | "linkText" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when target is set or target is set; type: TEXT *)
  | "linkAttributes" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when target is set or target is set; type: TEXT *)

title: column-b-column-formatting-property
text: <column-b-column-formatting-property> ::= "htmlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type in (NATIVE_PLAIN, NATIVE_PLAIN_LOV); type: HTML *)

title: column-b-source-property
text:
<column-b-source-property> ::= "primaryKey" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type != NATIVE_ROW_SELECTOR; type: YES NO *)
  | "dataType" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "availableOnClient" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when primaryKey = N and dataType not in (BLOB, CLOB, BFILE, SDO_GEOMETRY); type: YES NO *)
  | "valueProtected" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when availableOnClient = Y; type: YES NO *)
  | "timezoneAware" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when dataType = DATE; type: TEXT *)

title: column-b-column-filter-property
text:
<column-b-column-filter-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "none" | "defaultBasedOnColumnType" | "definedLovExactMatch" | "definedLovWordContains" | "namedLovExactMatch" | "namedLovWordContains" ) (* required; applies when type NOT_STARTS_WITH_ANY NATIVE_HIDDEN_COLUMN, NATIVE_PLAIN_LOV, NATIVE_RICH_TEXT, NATIVE_ROW_SELECTOR, TMPL_; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "namedLov" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (S, C); type: SQL *)
  | "dateRanges" ":" <ws> ( "all" | "past" | "future" ) (* required; applies when dataType = DATE and type = D; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "none" | "defaultBasedOnColumnType" | "definedLovExactMatch" | "definedLovWordContains" | "namedLovExactMatch" | "namedLovWordContains" ) (* required; applies when type = NATIVE_PLAIN_LOV; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (S, C); type: SQL *)

title: column-b-advanced-property
text:
<column-b-advanced-property> ::= "htmlDomId" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type != NATIVE_ROW_SELECTOR; type: TEXT *)
  | "endUserAlias" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)

title: column-b-gen-ai-property
