  | "staticValues" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = STATIC; type: STATIC LOV *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "sortDirection" ":" <ws> ( "asc" | "desc" ) (* required; applies when type = DISTINCT; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "includeNullOption" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type supports FC_LOV_DISPLAY_NULL and type is set; type: YES NO *)
  | "nullDisplayValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when includeNullOption = Y; type: TEXT *)

title: checkbox-b-cascading-lov-property
text:
<checkbox-b-cascading-lov-property> ::= "parentFilter" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = SHARED; type: FACET *)
  | "lovColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when parentFilter is set; type: TEXT *)
  | "parentRequired" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when parentFilter is set; type: YES NO *)

title: checkbox-b-layout-property
text:
<checkbox-b-layout-property> ::= "sequence" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; type: NUMBER *)
  | "filterGroup" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; type: COMPONENT *)

title: checkbox-b-appearance-property
text:
<checkbox-b-appearance-property> ::= "valuePlaceholder" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type supports PLACEHOLDER; type: TEXT *)
  | "icon" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type != NATIVE_SEARCH; type: ICON *)
  | "formatMask" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type supports FORMAT_MASK_DATE and dataType in (DATE, TIMESTAMP, TIMESTAMP_TZ, TIMESTAMP_LTZ); type: COMBOBOX *)

title: checkbox-b-source-property
text:
<checkbox-b-source-property> ::= "databaseColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type != NATIVE_SEARCH; type: TEXT *)
  | "dataType" ":" <ws> ( "varchar2" | "number" | "date" | "timestamp" | "timestampWithTimeZone" | "timestampWithLocalTimeZone" | "intervalYearToMonth" | "intervalDayToSecond" | "clob" | "blob" | "boolean" | "rowid" | "bfile" | "sdoGeometry" ) (* required; applies when type != NATIVE_SEARCH; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: checkbox-b-default-property
text:
<checkbox-b-default-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "static" | "item" | "sqlQuerySingleValue" | "sqlQueryMultipleValues" | "expression" | "functionBody" | "sequence" ) (* applies when type supports SOURCE; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = STATIC_TEXT_WITH_SUBSTITUTIONS; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = ITEM; type: ITEM *)
  | "sqlQuerySingleValue" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL_QUERY; type: SQL *)
  | "sqlQueryMultipleValues" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL_QUERY_COLON; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "sequence" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = SEQUENCE; type: TEXT *)

title: checkbox-b-depending-on-property
text:
<checkbox-b-depending-on-property> ::= "checkbox" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when type != NATIVE_SEARCH; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "=" | "!=" | "inList" | "notInList" | "isNull" | "isNotNull" ) (* required; applies when checkbox is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (EQUALS, NOT_EQUALS); type: TEXT *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (IN_LIST, NOT_IN_LIST); type: TEXT *)

title: checkbox-b-server-side-condition-property
text:
<checkbox-b-server-side-condition-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: SELECT LIST; large enum list omitted *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS); type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "page" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_EQUALS_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_EQUAL_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "pages" ":" <ws> <array-of-number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_IN_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_IN_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "text" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST, VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_NOT_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST); type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (DISPLAY_COND_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_NOT_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_EQUAL_COND_TEXT, DISP_COND_NOT_EQUAL_COND_TEXT); type: TEXT *)

title: checkbox-b-security-property
text:
<checkbox-b-security-property> ::= "authorizationScheme" ":" <ws> <reference> (* type: COMPONENT *)
  | "encryptSessionState" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type supports ENCRYPT; type: YES NO *)
  | "escapeSpecialChars" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type supports ESCAPE_OUTPUT; type: YES NO *)

title: checkbox-b-comments-property
text:
<checkbox-b-comments-property> ::= "comments" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)

(* layer *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: layer-direct-property
text:
<layer-direct-property> ::= "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "layerType" ":" <ws> ( "points" | "lines" | "polygons" | "heatMap" | "extrudedPolygons" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: layer-source-property
text:
<layer-source-property> ::= "location" ":" <ws> ( "localDatabase" | "restEnabledSql" | "restSource" | "jsonDualityView" | "jsonSource" | "regionSource" | "sampleData" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "remoteServer" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = REMOTE; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "sampleData" ":" <ws> ( "employees" | "tasks" | "products" | "projects" ) (* required; applies when location = SAMPLE_DATA; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when location in (LOCAL, REMOTE); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "tableOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = TABLE; type: OWNER *)
  | "tableName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = TABLE; type: TABLE *)
  | "includeRowidColumn" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type = TABLE and remoteServer supports IS_ORACLE or not set; type: YES NO *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = TABLE; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "graphOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = GRAPH; type: OWNER *)
  | "graphName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = GRAPH; type: GRAPH *)
  | "matchClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = GRAPH; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "columnsClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = GRAPH; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = GRAPH; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = TABLE; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = GRAPH; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "restSource" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = WEB_SOURCE; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "jsonDualityView" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = DUALITY_VIEW; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "jsonSource" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = JSON_COLLECTION; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "pageItemsToSubmit" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when location != REGION_SOURCE; type: ITEM *)
  | "optimizerHint" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when location in (LOCAL, REMOTE, WEB_SOURCE, DUALITY_VIEW, JSON_COLLECTION); type: TEXT *)
  | "useSpatialIndex" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when location in (LOCAL, REMOTE, REGION_SOURCE); type: YES NO *)
  | "useVectorTiles" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when location = LOCAL and type in (TABLE, SQL) and lazyLoading = Y; type: YES NO *)

title: layer-data-profile-property
text:
<layer-data-profile-property> ::= "nestedRows" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when restSource supports HAS_ARRAY_COLUMNS; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "nestedRows" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when jsonDualityView supports HAS_ARRAY_COLUMNS; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "nestedRows" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when jsonSource supports HAS_ARRAY_COLUMNS; type: COMPONENT *)

title: layer-rest-synchronization-property
text: <layer-rest-synchronization-property> ::= "useLocalTable" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when restSource supports HAS_SYNC_HAS_NO_ARRAY_COLUMNS or property matches or nestedRows supports IS_SYNCED; type: YES NO *)

title: layer-external-filter-and-order-by-property
text:
<layer-external-filter-and-order-by-property> ::= "enabled" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when restSource is set and useLocalTable in (N, $NULL$) or not set; type: YES NO *)
  | "filter" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when enabled = Y; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "orderBy" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when enabled = Y; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: layer-local-post-processing-property
text:
<layer-local-post-processing-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "whereOrderByClause" | "sqlQuery" | "plsqlFunctionBody" ) (* applies when restSource is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "whereOrderByClause" | "sqlQuery" | "plsqlFunctionBody" ) (* applies when jsonDualityView is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "whereOrderByClause" | "sqlQuery" | "plsqlFunctionBody" ) (* applies when jsonSource is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)

title: layer-remote-cache-property
text:
<layer-remote-cache-property> ::= "caching" ":" <ws> ( "allUsers" | "user" | "session" ) (* applies when location = REMOTE; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "timeout" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when caching is set; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: layer-row-assignment-property
text:
<layer-row-assignment-property> ::= "column" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when location = REGION_SOURCE; type: COLUMN *)
  | "valueForThisLayer" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when column is set; type: TEXT *)

title: layer-column-mapping-property
text:
<layer-column-mapping-property> ::= "geometryColumnDataType" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when location != REMOTE; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "geometryColumnDataType" ":" <ws> ( "geojson" | "longitudeLatitude" ) (* required; applies when location = REMOTE; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "geometryColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when geometryColumnDataType = SDO_GEOMETRY; type: COLUMN *)
  | "geojsonColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when geometryColumnDataType = GEOJSON or not set and geometryColumnDataType = GEOJSON or not set; type: COLUMN *)
  | "longitudeColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when geometryColumnDataType = LONLAT_COLUMNS or not set and geometryColumnDataType = LONLAT_COLUMNS or not set; type: COLUMN *)
  | "latitudeColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when geometryColumnDataType = LONLAT_COLUMNS or not set and geometryColumnDataType = LONLAT_COLUMNS or not set; type: COLUMN *)
  | "primaryKeyColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when location is set; type: COLUMN *)

title: layer-point-objects-property
text:
<layer-point-objects-property> ::= "style" ":" <ws> ( "svg" | "icon" ) (* required; applies when layerType = POINT; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "iconSource" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when style = ICON; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "iconColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when iconSource = DYNAMIC_CLASS; type: COLUMN *)
  | "imageUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when iconSource = URL; type: TEXT *)
  | "iconCssClasses" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when iconSource = STATIC_CLASS; type: ICON *)
  | "shape" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when style = SVG; type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "shapeScale" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when style = SVG; type: TEXT *)

title: layer-appearance-property
text:
<layer-appearance-property> ::= "useColorScheme" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "colorScheme" ":" <ws> ( "sequential" | "diverging" | "qualitative" ) (* applies when useColorScheme = Y; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "schemeName" ":" <ws> ( "burgundy" | "burgundyToYellow" | "redToOrange" | "orangeToYellow" | "peach" | "pinkToYellow" | "mint" | "blueToGreen" | "darkMint" | "emerald" | "blueToYellow" | "teal" | "tealToGreen" | "purple" | "purpleToOrange" | "sunset" | "magenta" | "darkSunset" | "brownToYellow" ) (* required; applies when colorScheme = SEQUENTIAL; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "schemeName" ":" <ws> ( "armyToRose" | "fallColors" | "geyser" | "temps" | "tealToRose" | "tropicColors" | "earthColors" ) (* required; applies when colorScheme = DIVERGING; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "schemeName" ":" <ws> ( "antique" | "bold" | "pastel" | "prism" | "safe" | "vivid" ) (* required; applies when colorScheme = QUALITATIVE; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "colorScheme" ":" <ws> ( "sequential" | "diverging" | "qualitative" ) (* applies when layerType = HEATMAP; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "schemeName" ":" <ws> ( "burgundy" | "burgundyToYellow" | "redToOrange" | "orangeToYellow" | "peach" | "pinkToYellow" | "mint" | "blueToGreen" | "darkMint" | "emerald" | "blueToYellow" | "teal" | "tealToGreen" | "purple" | "purpleToOrange" | "sunset" | "magenta" | "darkSunset" | "brownToYellow" ) (* required; applies when colorScheme = SEQUENTIAL; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "schemeName" ":" <ws> ( "armyToRose" | "fallColors" | "geyser" | "temps" | "tealToRose" | "tropicColors" | "earthColors" ) (* required; applies when colorScheme = DIVERGING; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "schemeName" ":" <ws> ( "antique" | "bold" | "pastel" | "prism" | "safe" | "vivid" ) (* required; applies when colorScheme = QUALITATIVE; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "customColorList" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when layerType = HEATMAP and colorScheme is not set; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "fillColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLOR *)
  | "customColorList" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when useColorScheme = Y and colorScheme is not set; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "valueColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when layerType = HEATMAP; type: COLUMN *)
  | "colorValueColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: COLUMN *)
  | "extrusionValueColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: COLUMN *)
  | "unit" ":" <ws> ( "meter" | "kilometer" | "foot" | "mile" ) (* required; applies when extrusionValueColumn is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fillOpacity" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "strokeStyle" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when layerType = LINE; type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "strokeColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when layerType in (POLYGON, LINE); type: COLOR *)
  | "strokeWidth" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when layerType in (POLYGON, LINE); type: TEXT *)
  | "fillColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when layerType = POINT and iconSource in ($NULL$, STATIC_CLASS, DYNAMIC_CLASS) or not set; type: COLOR *)
  | "fillOpacity" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when layerType = POINT and iconSource in ($NULL$, STATIC_CLASS, DYNAMIC_CLASS) or not set; type: TEXT *)
  | "strokeColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when style = SVG and useColorScheme in (N, $NULL$) or not set; type: COLOR *)
  | "strokeWidth" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when style = SVG and useColorScheme in (N, $NULL$) or not set; type: TEXT *)

title: layer-point-clustering-property
text:
<layer-point-clustering-property> ::= "enable" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when layerType = POINT and useVectorTiles in (N, $NULL$) or not set; type: YES NO *)
  | "clusteringRadius" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when enable = Y; type: INTEGER *)
  | "iconUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when iconSource = URL and enable = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "iconCssClasses" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when iconSource in (STATIC_CLASS, DYNAMIC_CLASS) and enable = Y; type: ICON *)
  | "shape" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when style = SVG and enable = Y; type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "fillColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when iconSource in ($NULL$, STATIC_CLASS, DYNAMIC_CLASS) or not set and enable = Y; type: COLOR *)
  | "shapeScale" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when style = SVG and enable = Y; type: TEXT *)
  | "tooltip" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when enable = Y; type: HTML *)

title: layer-tooltip-property
text:
<layer-tooltip-property> ::= "advancedFormatting" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when layerType != HEATMAP; type: YES NO *)
  | "column" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when advancedFormatting = N; type: COLUMN *)
  | "htmlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when advancedFormatting = Y; type: HTML *)
  | "cssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when advancedFormatting = Y; type: COMBOBOX *)

title: layer-link-property
text:
<layer-link-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when layerType != HEATMAP; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "target" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when type = REDIRECT_PAGE; type: LINK_IN_APP *)
  | "target" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when type = REDIRECT_APP; type: LINK_IN_DIFF_APP *)
  | "targetUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = REDIRECT_URL; type: TEXT *)

title: layer-info-window-property
text:
<layer-info-window-property> ::= "advancedFormatting" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when layerType != HEATMAP and type is not set; type: YES NO *)
  | "titleColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when advancedFormatting = N and type is not set; type: COLUMN *)

  | "from" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = COLUMN and operator in (BETWEEN, NBETWEEN); type: TEXT *)
  | "to" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = COLUMN and operator in (BETWEEN, NBETWEEN); type: TEXT *)

  | "caseSensitive" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type = ROW or operator in (C, NC, S, NS, REGEXP); type: YES NO *)

title: filter-b-advanced-property

(* highlight *)

  | "operator" ":" <ws> ( "equals" | "notEquals" | "greaterThan" | "greaterThanOrEquals" | "lessThan" | "lessThanOrEquals" | "isEmpty" | "isNotEmpty" | "in" | "notIn" | "between" | "notBetween" | "contains" | "doesNotContain" | "startsWith" | "doesNotStartWith" | "matchesRegexp" | "inTheLast" | "notInTheLast" | "inTheNext" | "notInTheNext" ) (* required; applies when type = COLUMN; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = COLUMN and operator not in (N, NN, BETWEEN, NBETWEEN, LAST, NLAST, NEXT, NNEXT); type: TEXT *)

title: sort-b-sort-property

title: search-source-server-side-condition-property
text:
<search-source-server-side-condition-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: SELECT LIST; large enum list omitted *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS); type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "page" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_EQUALS_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_EQUAL_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "pages" ":" <ws> <array-of-number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_IN_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_IN_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "text" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST, VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_NOT_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST); type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (DISPLAY_COND_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_NOT_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_EQUAL_COND_TEXT, DISP_COND_NOT_EQUAL_COND_TEXT); type: TEXT *)

title: search-source-comments-property

<search-source-comments-property> ::= "comments" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)

(* series *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: series-direct-property
text:
<series-direct-property> ::= "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "area" | "bar" | "line" | "lineWithArea" | "barRange" | "areaRange" ) (* required; applies when type = combo; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "barRange" | "areaRange" ) (* required; applies when type = range; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "area" | "bar" | "line" | "lineWithArea" | "scatter" | "bubble" | "barRange" | "areaRange" ) (* required; applies when type = polar; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "area" | "areaRange" | "line" ) (* required; applies when type = radar; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "area" | "bar" | "boxPlot" | "line" | "lineWithArea" ) (* required; applies when type = boxPlot; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: series-source-property
text:
<series-source-property> ::= "location" ":" <ws> ( "localDatabase" | "restEnabledSql" | "restSource" | "jsonDualityView" | "jsonSource" | "regionSource" | "sampleData" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "remoteServer" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = REMOTE; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "sampleData" ":" <ws> ( "employees" | "tasks" | "products" | "projects" ) (* required; applies when location = SAMPLE_DATA; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when location in (LOCAL, REMOTE); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "tableOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = TABLE; type: OWNER *)
  | "tableName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = TABLE; type: TABLE *)
  | "includeRowidColumn" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type = TABLE and remoteServer supports IS_ORACLE or not set; type: YES NO *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = TABLE; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "graphOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = GRAPH; type: OWNER *)
  | "graphName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = GRAPH; type: GRAPH *)
  | "matchClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = GRAPH; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "columnsClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = GRAPH; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = GRAPH; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "restSource" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = WEB_SOURCE; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "jsonDualityView" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = DUALITY_VIEW; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "jsonSource" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = JSON_COLLECTION; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "pageItemsToSubmit" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when location != REGION_SOURCE; type: ITEM *)
  | "optimizerHint" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when location in (LOCAL, REMOTE, WEB_SOURCE, DUALITY_VIEW, JSON_COLLECTION); type: TEXT *)

title: series-order-by-property
text:
<series-order-by-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "staticValue" | "item" ) (* applies when location in (LOCAL, REMOTE, SAMPLE_DATA) and type in (TABLE, GRAPH, SQL, FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL, $NULL$) or not set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = STATIC and type in (TABLE, SQL, FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL, $NULL$) or not set; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when type = ITEM and type in (TABLE, SQL, FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL, $NULL$) or not set; type: ORDER BY ITEM *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = STATIC and type = GRAPH; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when type = ITEM and type = GRAPH; type: ORDER BY ITEM *)

title: series-data-profile-property
text:
<series-data-profile-property> ::= "nestedRows" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when restSource supports HAS_ARRAY_COLUMNS; type: COMPONENT *)

  | "nestedRows" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when jsonSource supports HAS_ARRAY_COLUMNS; type: COMPONENT *)

title: series-rest-synchronization-property
text: <series-rest-synchronization-property> ::= "useLocalTable" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when restSource supports HAS_SYNC_HAS_NO_ARRAY_COLUMNS or property matches or nestedRows supports IS_SYNCED; type: YES NO *)

title: series-external-filter-and-order-by-property
text:
<series-external-filter-and-order-by-property> ::= "enabled" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when restSource is set and useLocalTable in (N, $NULL$) or not set; type: YES NO *)
  | "filter" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when enabled = Y; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "orderByType" ":" <ws> ( "staticValue" | "item" ) (* applies when enabled = Y; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "orderBy" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when orderByType = STATIC; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when orderByType = ITEM; type: ORDER BY ITEM *)

title: series-local-post-processing-property

<series-local-post-processing-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "whereOrderByClause" | "sqlQuery" | "plsqlFunctionBody" ) (* applies when restSource is set; type: SELECT LIST *)

  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)

  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "orderByType" ":" <ws> ( "staticValue" | "item" ) (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when orderByType = STATIC; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when orderByType = ITEM; type: ORDER BY ITEM *)
  | "orderByItem" ":" <ws> <value> (* applies when type in (SQL, FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL); type: ORDER BY ITEM *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "whereOrderByClause" | "sqlQuery" | "plsqlFunctionBody" ) (* applies when jsonDualityView is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "orderByType" ":" <ws> ( "staticValue" | "item" ) (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when orderByType = STATIC; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when orderByType = ITEM; type: ORDER BY ITEM *)
  | "orderByItem" ":" <ws> <value> (* applies when type in (SQL, FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL); type: ORDER BY ITEM *)

  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "orderByType" ":" <ws> ( "staticValue" | "item" ) (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when orderByType = STATIC; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when orderByType = ITEM; type: ORDER BY ITEM *)
  | "orderByItem" ":" <ws> <value> (* applies when type in (SQL, FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL); type: ORDER BY ITEM *)

title: series-remote-cache-property

title: series-column-mapping-property
text:
<series-column-mapping-property> ::= "seriesName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type not in (dial, stock, gantt); type: COLUMN *)
  | "label" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type not in (dial, gantt); type: COLUMN *)
  | "label" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = dial; type: COLUMN *)
  | "valueAggregation" ":" <ws> ( "count" | "sum" | "average" | "median" | "min" | "max" | "countDistinct" | "approxCountDistinct" ) (* applies when property matches and type not in (SQL, FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL) or not set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when property matches and valueAggregation in ($NULL$, SUM, AVG, MEDIAN, MIN, MAX, COUNT_DISTINCT, APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT) or not set; type: COLUMN *)
  | "open" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = stock; type: COLUMN *)
  | "low" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = stock or type in (barRange, areaRange) or type in (barRange, areaRange) or type in (barRange, areaRange) or type = areaRange; type: COLUMN *)
  | "high" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = stock or type in (barRange, areaRange) or type in (barRange, areaRange) or type in (barRange, areaRange) or type = areaRange; type: COLUMN *)
  | "low" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = boxPlot; type: COLUMN *)
  | "high" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = boxPlot; type: COLUMN *)
  | "close" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = stock; type: COLUMN *)
  | "volume" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = stock; type: COLUMN *)
  | "x" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (bubble, scatter) or type in (bubble, scatter); type: COLUMN *)
  | "y" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (bubble, scatter) or type in (bubble, scatter); type: COLUMN *)
  | "z" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (bar, bubble) or type in (bar, barRange) or type = barRange or type in (bar, bubble, barRange) or type in (bar, boxPlot); type: COLUMN *)
  | "targetValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = funnel; type: COLUMN *)
  | "minValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = dial; type: COLUMN *)
  | "maxValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = dial; type: COLUMN *)
  | "rowId" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = gantt; type: COLUMN *)
  | "rowName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = gantt; type: COLUMN *)
  | "taskId" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = gantt; type: COLUMN *)
  | "taskName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = gantt; type: COLUMN *)
  | "taskStartDate" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = gantt; type: COLUMN *)
  | "taskEndDate" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = gantt; type: COLUMN *)
  | "progress" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = gantt; type: COLUMN *)
  | "baselineStartDate" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = gantt; type: COLUMN *)
  | "baselineEndDate" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = gantt; type: COLUMN *)
  | "customTooltip" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)
  | "legendTooltip" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (area, bar, bubble, line, lineWithArea, scatter, stock) or type in (area, bar, line, lineWithArea) or type in (area, bar, line, lineWithArea, bubble, scatter) or type in (area, line) or type in (area, bar, line, lineWithArea, boxPlot); type: COLUMN *)
  | "labelTooltip" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (area, bar, bubble, line, lineWithArea, scatter, stock) or type in (area, bar, line, lineWithArea) or type in (area, bar, line, lineWithArea, bubble, scatter) or type in (area, line) or type in (area, bar, line, lineWithArea, boxPlot); type: COLUMN *)
  | "customColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type != gantt; type: COLUMN *)

title: series-viewport-property
text:
<series-viewport-property> ::= "startDateSourceType" ":" <ws> ( "databaseColumn" | "item" ) (* applies when type = gantt; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "startDateColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = gantt and startDateSourceType = DB_COLUMN; type: COLUMN *)
  | "startDateItem" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = gantt and startDateSourceType = ITEM; type: ITEM *)
  | "endDateSourceType" ":" <ws> ( "databaseColumn" | "item" ) (* applies when type = gantt; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "endDateColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = gantt and endDateSourceType = DB_COLUMN; type: COLUMN *)
  | "endDateItem" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = gantt and endDateSourceType = ITEM; type: ITEM *)

title: series-appearance-property
text:
<series-appearance-property> ::= "taskCssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when type = gantt; type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "progressCssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when type = gantt; type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "baselineCssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when type = gantt; type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "color" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type not in (gantt); type: COLOR *)
  | "plotAreaColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = dial; type: COLOR *)
  | "q2Color" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = boxPlot; type: COLOR *)
  | "q3Color" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = boxPlot; type: COLOR *)
  | "assignedToY2Axis" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type in (area, bar, line, lineWithArea, boxPlot, combo); type: YES NO *)
  | "stackCategory" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (area, bar, line, lineWithArea, combo); type: TEXT *)

title: series-link-property
text:
<series-link-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "redirectThisApp" | "redirectOtherApp" | "redirectUrl" | "redirectUrlReturnedByFirstCol" ) (* applies when type not in (dial, gantt); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "target" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when type = REDIRECT_PAGE; type: LINK_IN_APP *)
  | "target" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when type = REDIRECT_APP; type: LINK_IN_DIFF_APP *)
  | "targetUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = REDIRECT_URL; type: TEXT *)

title: series-thresholds-property
text:
<series-thresholds-property> ::= "values" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = dial; type: TEXT *)
  | "colors" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = dial; type: TEXT *)
  | "display" ":" <ws> ( "all" | "onIndicator" | "currentThresholdOnly" ) (* applies when type = dial; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: series-reference-lines-property
text:
<series-reference-lines-property> ::= "values" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = dial; type: TEXT *)
  | "colors" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = dial; type: TEXT *)

title: series-line-property
text:
<series-line-property> ::= "style" ":" <ws> ( "dotted" | "dashed" | "solid" ) (* required; applies when type in (line, lineWithArea, bubble, scatter, combo); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "width" ":" <ws> <number> (* applies when type in (line, lineWithArea, bubble, scatter, combo); type: INTEGER *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "centeredStepped" | "curved" | "centeredSegmented" | "stepped" | "segmented" | "straight" | "auto" | "none" ) (* required; applies when type in (line, lineWithArea, area, scatter) or type = areaRange or type in (line, lineWithArea, area, areaRange) or type in (line, lineWithArea, area) or type in (line, lineWithArea, area, scatter, areaRange) or type in (line, areaRange, area); type: SELECT LIST *)

title: series-marker-property
text:
<series-marker-property> ::= "show" ":" <ws> ( "auto" | "true" | "false" ) (* required; applies when type in (line, lineWithArea, scatter, area, bubble, boxPlot) or type = areaRange or type in (line, lineWithArea, area, areaRange) or type in (line, lineWithArea, area) or type in (line, lineWithArea, area, scatter, areaRange) or type in (line, areaRange, area); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "shape" ":" <ws> ( "auto" | "circle" | "diamond" | "human" | "plus" | "square" | "star" | "triangleDown" | "triangleUp" ) (* required; applies when type in (line, lineWithArea, scatter, area, bubble, boxPlot, combo, range) and show != off; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: series-label-property
text:
<series-label-property> ::= "show" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "position" ":" <ws> ( "center" | "outsideSlice" | "aboveMarker" | "belowMarker" | "beforeMarker" | "afterMarker" | "insideBarEdge" | "outsideBarEdge" | "auto" | "none" | "start" ) (* required; applies when show = Y and type not in (gantt); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "displayAs" ":" <ws> ( "label" | "percentage" | "value" | "labelValue" | "labelPercentage" | "labelPercentageValue" | "percentageValue" ) (* required; applies when show = Y and type in (pie, donut); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "cssStyling" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when show = Y and type not in (dial, gantt); type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "fontFamily" ":" <ws> ( "arial" | "arialBlack" | "bookman" | "comicSansMs" | "courier" | "courierNew" | "garamond" | "georgia" | "helvetica" | "impact" | "palatino" | "times" | "timesNewRoman" | "trebuchetMs" | "verdana" ) (* applies when show = Y; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontStyle" ":" <ws> ( "normal" | "italic" | "oblique" ) (* applies when show = Y; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontSize" ":" <ws> ( "8" | "10" | "12" | "14" | "16" | "18" | "20" | "22" ) (* applies when show = Y; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "fontColor" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when show = Y; type: COLOR *)
  | "taskLabelPosition" ":" <ws> ( "start" | "end" | "innerCenter" | "innerStart" | "innerEnd" ) (* required; applies when type = gantt and show = Y; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: series-performance-property
text: <series-performance-property> ::= "maxRowsToProcess" ":" <ws> <number> (* applies when type != dial; type: INTEGER *)

title: series-server-side-condition-property
text:
<series-server-side-condition-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: SELECT LIST; large enum list omitted *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS); type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "page" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_EQUALS_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_EQUAL_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "pages" ":" <ws> <array-of-number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_IN_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_IN_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "text" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST, VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_NOT_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST); type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (DISPLAY_COND_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_NOT_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_EQUAL_COND_TEXT, DISP_COND_NOT_EQUAL_COND_TEXT); type: TEXT *)

title: series-child-component
text:
<series-child-component> ::= <parameter-k>

(* parameter *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: parameter-k-parameter-property
text: <parameter-k-parameter-property> ::= "ignoreOutput" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when name supports IN_OUT_PARAMETER and name NOT_FEATURES FETCH_COLLECTION_OPERATION_PRM; type: YES NO *)

title: parameter-k-value-property
text:
<parameter-k-value-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "staticValue" | "restSourceDefault" | "item" | "sqlQuery" | "expression" | "functionBody" | "collectionClob" | "preference" | "parentColumn" | "null" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = STATIC and name NOT_FEATURES BOOLEAN_PARAMETER; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> ( "true" | "false" ) (* required; applies when type = STATIC and name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL_QUERY; type: SQL *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = ITEM; type: ITEM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = PREFERENCE; type: TEXT *)
  | "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = COLLECTION; type: TEXT *)
  | "formatMask" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when name supports NUMBER_PARAMETER, DATE_PARAMETER, TIMESTAMP_PARAMETER, TIMESTAMP_TZ_PARAMETER and type in (STATIC, ITEM, PREFERENCE); type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "trueValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER and type in (ITEM, PREFERENCE); type: TEXT *)
  | "falseValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER and type in (ITEM, PREFERENCE); type: TEXT *)
  | "column" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when type = PARENT_COLUMN; type: COMPONENT *)

(* validation *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: validation-b-validation-property
text:
<validation-b-validation-property> ::= "editableRegion" ":" <ws> <reference> (* type: COMPONENT *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "rowsReturned" | "noRowsReturned" | "expression" | "plsqlError" | "functionBodyReturningBoolean" | "functionBody" | "itemIsNotNull" | "itemIsNotNullOrZero" | "itemIsNotZero" | "itemContainsNoSpaces" | "itemIsAlphanumeric" | "itemIsNumeric" | "itemIsAValidDate" | "itemIsAValidTimestamp" | "item=Value" | "item!=Value" | "itemIsContainedInValue" | "itemIsNotContainedInValue" | "itemContainsOnlyCharsInValue" | "itemContainsAtLeastOneOfCharsInValue" | "itemContainsNoneOfCharsInValue" | "itemMatchesRegexp" ) (* required; applies when editableRegion is not set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS); type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_BOOLEAN; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_ERR_TEXT; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "plsqlCodeRaisingError" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = PLSQL_ERROR; type: PLSQL *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type starts with ITEM, REGULAR_EXPRESSION; type: ITEM *)
  | "regexp" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = REGULAR_EXPRESSION; type: TEXT *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "rowsReturned" | "noRowsReturned" | "expression" | "plsqlError" | "functionBodyReturningBoolean" | "functionBody" | "columnIsNotNull" | "columnIsNotNullOrZero" | "columnIsNotZero" | "columnContainsNoSpaces" | "columnIsAlphanumeric" | "columnIsNumeric" | "columnIsAValidDate" | "columnIsAValidTimestamp" | "column=Value" | "column!=Value" | "columnIsContainedInValue" | "columnIsNotContainedInValue" | "columnContainsOnlyCharsInValue" | "columnContainsAtLeastOneOfCharsInValue" | "columnContainsNoneOfCharsInValue" | "columnMatchesRegexp" ) (* required; applies when editableRegion is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS); type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_BOOLEAN; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_ERR_TEXT; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "plsqlCodeRaisingError" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = PLSQL_ERROR; type: PLSQL *)
  | "column" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type starts with ITEM, REGULAR_EXPRESSION; type: REGION COLUMN *)
  | "regexp" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = REGULAR_EXPRESSION; type: TEXT *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "alwaysExecute" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)

title: validation-b-error-property
text:
<validation-b-error-property> ::= "errorMessage" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type != FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_ERR_TEXT or not set and type != FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_ERR_TEXT or not set; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "displayLocation" ":" <ws> ( "inlineWithFieldAndInNotification" | "inlineWithField" | "inlineInNotification" | "onErrorPage" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "associatedItem" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when editableRegion is not set; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "associatedColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when editableRegion is set; type: REGION COLUMN *)

title: validation-b-server-side-condition-property
text:
<validation-b-server-side-condition-property> ::= "whenButtonPressed" ":" <ws> <reference> (* type: COMPONENT *)
  | "executionScope" ":" <ws> ( "forCreatedAndModifiedRows" | "allSubmittedRows" ) (* required; applies when editableRegion is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: SELECT LIST; large enum list omitted *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS); type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)

  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "page" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_EQUALS_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_EQUAL_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "pages" ":" <ws> <array-of-number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_IN_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_IN_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "text" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
