<report-layout-file-property> ::= "fileName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type not in (RTF_FILE, XSL_FILE, XSL_GENERIC); type: TEXT *)
  | "mimeType" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type not in (RTF_FILE, XSL_FILE, XSL_GENERIC); type: TEXT *)
  | "content" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when type not in (RTF_FILE, XSL_FILE, XSL_GENERIC); type: BLOB *)

title: report-layout-data-loop-property
text: <report-layout-data-loop-property> ::= "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type not in (RTF_FILE, XSL_FILE, XSL_GENERIC); type: TEXT *)

title: report-layout-templates-property
text:
<report-layout-templates-property> ::= "page" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (RTF_FILE, XSL_FILE, XSL_GENERIC); type: CLOB *)
  | "columnHeading" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = XSL_GENERIC; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "column" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = XSL_GENERIC; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "columnWidth" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = XSL_GENERIC; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: report-layout-comments-property
text:
<report-layout-comments-property> ::= "comments" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)

(* reportQuery *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: report-query-output-property
text:
<report-query-output-property> ::= "fileName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "format" ":" <ws> ( "pdf" | "word" | "excel" | "html" | "xml" ) (* required; applies when type = INSTANCE or remotePrintServer NOT_FEATURES AOP_SERVER; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "format" ":" <ws> ( "pdf" | "word" | "excel" | "html" | "powerpoint" | "markdown" | "csv" | "openDocumentText" | "openDocumentSpreadsheet" | "openDocumentPresentation" ) (* required; applies when remotePrintServer supports AOP_SERVER; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "formatItem" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when format is not set or not set and format is not set or not set; type: ITEM *)
  | "layout" ":" <ws> <reference> (* type: COMPONENT *)
  | "viewFileAs" ":" <ws> ( "attachment" | "inline" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: report-query-session-state-property
text:
<report-query-session-state-property> ::= "include" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "items" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when include = Y; type: ITEM *)

title: report-query-child-component
text:
<report-query-child-component> ::= <source-query>

(* sourceQuery *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: source-query-direct-property
text:
<source-query-direct-property> ::= "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "sequence" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; type: INTEGER *)

title: source-query-data-loop-property
text: <source-query-data-loop-property> ::= "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = INSTANCE or remotePrintServer supports AOP_SERVER; type: TEXT *)

title: source-query-source-property
text:
<source-query-source-property> ::= "location" ":" <ws> ( "localDatabase" | "restEnabledSql" | "restSource" | "jsonDualityView" | "jsonSource" | "sampleData" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "remoteServer" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = REMOTE; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "sampleData" ":" <ws> ( "employees" | "tasks" | "products" | "projects" ) (* required; applies when location = SAMPLE_DATA; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when location in (LOCAL, REMOTE); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "tableOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = TABLE; type: OWNER *)
  | "tableName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = TABLE; type: TABLE *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = TABLE; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "graphOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = GRAPH; type: OWNER *)
  | "graphName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = GRAPH; type: GRAPH *)
  | "matchClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = GRAPH; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "columnsClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = GRAPH; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = GRAPH; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = TABLE; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = GRAPH; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "restSource" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = WEB_SOURCE; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "jsonDualityView" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = DUALITY_VIEW; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "jsonSource" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = JSON_COLLECTION; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "optimizerHint" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when location in (LOCAL, REMOTE, WEB_SOURCE, DUALITY_VIEW, JSON_COLLECTION); type: TEXT *)

title: source-query-data-profile-property
text:
<source-query-data-profile-property> ::= "nestedRows" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when restSource supports HAS_ARRAY_COLUMNS; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "nestedRows" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when jsonDualityView supports HAS_ARRAY_COLUMNS; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "nestedRows" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when jsonSource supports HAS_ARRAY_COLUMNS; type: COMPONENT *)

title: source-query-rest-synchronization-property
text: <source-query-rest-synchronization-property> ::= "useLocalTable" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when restSource supports HAS_SYNC_HAS_NO_ARRAY_COLUMNS or property matches or nestedRows supports IS_SYNCED; type: YES NO *)

title: source-query-external-filter-and-order-by-property
text:
<source-query-external-filter-and-order-by-property> ::= "enabled" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when restSource is set and useLocalTable in (N, $NULL$) or not set; type: YES NO *)
  | "filter" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when enabled = Y; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "orderBy" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when enabled = Y; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: source-query-local-post-processing-property
text:
<source-query-local-post-processing-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "whereOrderByClause" | "sqlQuery" | "plsqlFunctionBody" ) (* applies when restSource is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "whereOrderByClause" | "sqlQuery" | "plsqlFunctionBody" ) (* applies when jsonDualityView is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "whereOrderByClause" | "sqlQuery" | "plsqlFunctionBody" ) (* applies when jsonSource is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)

title: source-query-remote-cache-property
text:
<source-query-remote-cache-property> ::= "caching" ":" <ws> ( "allUsers" | "user" | "session" ) (* applies when location = REMOTE; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "timeout" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when caching is set; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: source-query-child-component
text:
<source-query-child-component> ::= <parameter-e>

(* parameter *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: parameter-e-value-property
text:
<parameter-e-value-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "staticValue" | "restSourceDefault" | "item" | "sqlQuery" | "expression" | "functionBody" | "collectionClob" | "preference" | "null" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = STATIC and name NOT_FEATURES BOOLEAN_PARAMETER; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> ( "true" | "false" ) (* required; applies when type = STATIC and name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL_QUERY; type: SQL *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = ITEM; type: ITEM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = PREFERENCE; type: TEXT *)
  | "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = COLLECTION; type: TEXT *)
  | "formatMask" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when name supports NUMBER_PARAMETER, DATE_PARAMETER, TIMESTAMP_PARAMETER, TIMESTAMP_TZ_PARAMETER and type in (STATIC, ITEM, PREFERENCE); type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "trueValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER and type in (ITEM, PREFERENCE); type: TEXT *)
  | "falseValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER and type in (ITEM, PREFERENCE); type: TEXT *)

(* restDataSource *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: rest-data-source-data-profile-property
text:
<rest-data-source-data-profile-property> ::= "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "format" ":" <ws> ( "csv" | "json" | "xml" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "rowSelector" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when format in (JSON, XML); type: TEXT *)
  | "containsSingleRow" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when format in (JSON, XML); type: YES NO *)
  | "singleRowSelector" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when containsSingleRow = N and format != CSV; type: TEXT *)
  | "useRawSelectors" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when format = JSON; type: YES NO *)
  | "comments" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: rest-data-source-source-property
text:
<rest-data-source-source-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: SUPPORTED UI *)
  | "remoteServer" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when type != NATIVE_REST_ENABLED_SQL_QUERY; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "remoteServer" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when type = NATIVE_REST_ENABLED_SQL_QUERY; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "urlPathPrefix" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)

title: rest-data-source-advanced-property
text:
<rest-data-source-advanced-property> ::= "encoding" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: SELECT LIST; large enum list omitted *)
  | "numericChars" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "xmlNamespaces" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when format = XML; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "csvSeparator" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when format = CSV; type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "csvEnclosedBy" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when format = CSV; type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "skipRows" ":" <ws> <number> (* applies when format = CSV; type: NUMBER *)
  | "firstLineContainsHeaders" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when format = CSV; type: YES NO *)
  | "staticId" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: STATIC ID *)
  | "passEcid" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "httpTransferTimeout" ":" <ws> <number> (* type: INTEGER *)
  | "openapiUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)

title: rest-data-source-authentication-property
text:
<rest-data-source-authentication-property> ::= "credentials" ":" <ws> <reference> (* type: COMPONENT *)
  | "server" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when credentials is set; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "urlPathPrefix" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when server is set; type: TEXT *)

title: rest-data-source-synchronization-property
text:
<rest-data-source-synchronization-property> ::= "jobIsActive" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "localTableOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: OWNER *)
  | "localTableName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TABLE *)
  | "nestedRows" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when localTableName is set; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "append" | "merge" | "fullRefreshDelete" | "fullRefreshTruncate" ) (* required; applies when localTableName is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "schedule" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when localTableName is set; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "commitInterval" ":" <ws> <number> (* applies when localTableName is set; type: INTEGER *)
  | "httpRequestLimit" ":" <ws> <number> (* applies when localTableName is set; type: INTEGER *)

title: rest-data-source-synchronization-rate-limit-property
text:
<rest-data-source-synchronization-rate-limit-property> ::= "timeframe" ":" <ws> <number> (* applies when localTableName is set; type: INTEGER *)
  | "httpRequests" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when timeframe is set; type: INTEGER *)
  | "whenExceeded" ":" <ws> ( "raiseError" | "wait" ) (* required; applies when timeframe is set; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: rest-data-source-invocation-scope-property
text:
<rest-data-source-invocation-scope-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "staticValue" | "item" | "sqlQuery" | "expression" | "functionBody" ) (* applies when credentials is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "text" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = STATIC; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = STATIC; type: ITEM *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL_QUERY; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT *)

title: rest-data-source-rest-source-catalog-property
text:
<rest-data-source-rest-source-catalog-property> ::= "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "service" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "version" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)

title: rest-data-source-child-component
text:
<rest-data-source-child-component> ::= <data-profile-column-a>
  | <operation>
  | <parameter-a>
  | <synchronization-step>

(* dataProfileColumn *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: data-profile-column-a-source-property
text:
<data-profile-column-a-source-property> ::= "sequence" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; type: NUMBER *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "data" | "lookup" | "sqlExpression" | "sqlQuery" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "parentColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when format = JSON; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "lineNumber" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when containsSingleRow = N or not set and type = DATA; type: YES NO *)
  | "dataType" ":" <ws> ( "varchar2" | "number" | "date" | "timestamp" | "timestampWithLocalTimeZone" | "timestampWithTimeZone" | "clob" | "boolean" | "blob" | "geometrySdoGeometry" | "array" | "jsonDocument" ) (* required; applies when lineNumber = N or not set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "regexPattern" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "maxLength" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; type: INTEGER *)
  | "primaryKey" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)

title: data-profile-column-a-parsing-property
text:
<data-profile-column-a-parsing-property> ::= "selectorType" ":" <ws> ( "name" | "sequence" | "regexp" ) (* required; applies when type = DATA and format in (CSV); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "selector" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when selectorType in (NAME, REGEXP); type: TEXT *)
  | "columnNumber" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when selectorType = SEQ; type: INTEGER *)
  | "pathExpression" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when format in (JSON, XML) and type = DATA and lineNumber = N or not set; type: TEXT *)
  | "formatMask" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when dataType in (NUMBER, DATE, TIMESTAMP, TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, TIMESTAMP WITH LOCAL TIME ZONE) and type = DATA and lineNumber = N or not set; type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "hasTimeZone" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when dataType in (DATE, TIMESTAMP, TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, TIMESTAMP WITH LOCAL TIME ZONE) and type = DATA; type: YES NO *)
  | "decimalChar" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when dataType = NUMBER; type: TEXT *)
  | "groupChar" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when dataType = NUMBER; type: TEXT *)

title: data-profile-column-a-computation-property
text:
<data-profile-column-a-computation-property> ::= "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL_EXPRESSION; type: SQL EXPRESSION *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL_QUERY; type: SQL *)

title: data-profile-column-a-lookup-property
text:
<data-profile-column-a-lookup-property> ::= "tableOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = LOOKUP; type: OWNER *)
  | "tableName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = LOOKUP; type: TABLE *)
  | "returnColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = LOOKUP; type: COLUMN *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = LOOKUP; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "tableColumn1" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = LOOKUP; type: COLUMN *)
  | "dataColumn1" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = LOOKUP; type: TEXT *)
  | "tableColumn2" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)
  | "dataColumn2" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "tableColumn3" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)
  | "dataColumn3" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)

title: data-profile-column-a-transformation-property
text:
<data-profile-column-a-transformation-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "leftTrim" | "rightTrim" | "trim" | "replace" | "lower" | "upper" | "nullIf" | "regexpReplace" | "regexpNullIf" ) (* applies when dataType not in (BLOB, SDO_GEOMETRY, ARRAY) and type = DATA and lineNumber = N or not set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "trimChars" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (LTRIM, RTRIM, TRIM); type: TEXT *)
  | "find" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = REPLACE; type: TEXT *)
  | "regexp" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (REGEXP_REPLACE, REGEXP_NULLIF); type: TEXT *)
  | "replaceWith" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (REPLACE, REGEXP_REPLACE); type: TEXT *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = NULLIF; type: TEXT *)

title: data-profile-column-a-advanced-property
text:
<data-profile-column-a-advanced-property> ::= "staticId" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: STATIC ID *)
  | "sourceDataType" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = DATA and lineNumber = N or not set; type: TEXT *)
  | "sourceAttributeName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = DATA; type: TEXT *)
  | "additionalInformation" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = DATA; type: TEXT *)
  | "common" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)
  | "hidden" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)

title: data-profile-column-a-comments-property
text:
<data-profile-column-a-comments-property> ::= "comments" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)

(* operation *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: operation-operation-property
text:
<operation-operation-property> ::= "urlPattern" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "httpMethod" ":" <ws> ( "get" | "post" | "put" | "delete" | "patch" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "databaseOperation" ":" <ws> ( "fetchRows" | "fetchSingleRow" | "insert" | "update" | "delete" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)

title: operation-request-body-property
text:
<operation-request-body-property> ::= "template" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when httpMethod != GET; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "versionNumber" ":" <ws> ( "1" | "2" ) (* required; applies when httpMethod != GET; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: operation-remote-cache-property
text:
<operation-remote-cache-property> ::= "caching" ":" <ws> ( "allUsers" | "user" | "session" ) (* applies when httpMethod in (GET, POST) and databaseOperation in (FETCH_COLLECTION, FETCH_SINGLE_ROW) or not set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "timeout" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when caching is set; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: operation-advanced-property
text:
<operation-advanced-property> ::= "fixedPageSize" ":" <ws> <number> (* type: INTEGER *)
  | "allowFetchingAllRows" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when databaseOperation = FETCH_COLLECTION; type: YES NO *)
  | "fetchAllRowsTimeout" ":" <ws> <number> (* applies when allowFetchingAllRows = Y; type: INTEGER *)
  | "forceRaiseHttp404Error" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when databaseOperation = FETCH_COLLECTION; type: YES NO *)
  | "staticId" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: STATIC ID *)

title: operation-comments-property
text:
<operation-comments-property> ::= "comments" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)

(* parameter *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: parameter-a-parameter-property
text:
<parameter-a-parameter-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "urlPattern" | "urlQueryString" | "httpHeader" | "dataProfileColumn" | "requestOrResponseBody" | "httpStatusCode" | "httpReasonPhrase" | "httpCookie" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "dataType" ":" <ws> ( "string" | "numeric" | "date" | "timestamp" | "timestampWithTimeZone" | "boolean" | "binary" ) (* required; applies when type in (HEADER, COOKIE, URL_PATTERN, QUERY_STRING, BODY); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "direction" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "omitWhenValueIsEmpty" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type in (HEADER, COOKIE, QUERY_STRING) and static = N; type: YES NO *)

title: parameter-a-value-property
text:
<parameter-a-value-property> ::= "formatMask" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when dataType in (BOOLEAN, NUMBER, DATE, TIMESTAMP, TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE); type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "static" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type in (URL_PATTERN, QUERY_STRING, BODY, HEADER, COOKIE) and direction != OUT or not set; type: YES NO *)
  | "defaultValueType" ":" <ws> ( "staticValue" | "item" | "sqlQuery" | "expression" | "functionBody" ) (* required; applies when direction != OUT; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when defaultValueType = STATIC; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when defaultValueType = ITEM; type: ITEM *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when defaultValueType = SQL_QUERY; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when defaultValueType = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when defaultValueType = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT *)

title: parameter-a-validation-property
text:
<parameter-a-validation-property> ::= "required" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when static = N; type: YES NO *)
  | "regexPattern" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)

title: parameter-a-multiple-values-property
text:
<parameter-a-multiple-values-property> ::= "multipleValues" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when type = QUERY_STRING and omitWhenValueIsEmpty = Y; type: YES NO *)
  | "separator" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when multipleValues = Y; type: TEXT *)

title: parameter-a-advanced-property
text:
<parameter-a-advanced-property> ::= "useForRowSearch" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when static = N; type: YES NO *)
  | "staticId" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: STATIC ID *)

title: parameter-a-comments-property
text:
<parameter-a-comments-property> ::= "comments" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)

(* synchronizationStep *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: synchronization-step-execution-property
text:
<synchronization-step-execution-property> ::= "sequence" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; type: NUMBER *)
  | "active" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; type: YES NO *)

title: synchronization-step-child-component
text:
<synchronization-step-child-component> ::= <parameter-b>

(* parameter *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: parameter-b-value-property
text:
<parameter-b-value-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "staticValue" | "restSourceDefault" | "sqlQuery" | "expression" | "functionBody" | "null" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = STATIC and name NOT_FEATURES BOOLEAN_PARAMETER; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> ( "true" | "false" ) (* required; applies when type = STATIC and name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL_QUERY; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "formatMask" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when name supports NUMBER_PARAMETER, DATE_PARAMETER, TIMESTAMP_PARAMETER, TIMESTAMP_TZ_PARAMETER and type in (STATIC); type: COMBOBOX *)

(* role *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: role-subscription-property
text:
<role-subscription-property> ::= "master" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: SUBSCRIPTION *)

(* searchConfig *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: search-config-direct-property
text:
<search-config-direct-property> ::= "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "searchQueryPrefix" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "simple" | "vector" | "text" | "ubiquitous" | "apexList" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: search-config-source-property
text:
<search-config-source-property> ::= "list" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when type = APEX_LIST; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "location" ":" <ws> ( "localDatabase" | "restEnabledSql" | "restSource" | "jsonDualityView" | "jsonSource" | "sampleData" ) (* required; applies when type = SIMPLE; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "remoteServer" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = REMOTE; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "sampleData" ":" <ws> ( "employees" | "tasks" | "products" | "projects" ) (* required; applies when location = SAMPLE_DATA; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when location in (LOCAL, REMOTE); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "tableOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = TABLE; type: OWNER *)
  | "tableName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = TABLE; type: TABLE *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = TABLE; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "graphOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = GRAPH; type: OWNER *)
  | "graphName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = GRAPH; type: GRAPH *)
  | "matchClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = GRAPH; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "columnsClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = GRAPH; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = GRAPH; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "restSource" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = WEB_SOURCE; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "tableOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = TEXT_MANUAL and type = TABLE; type: OWNER *)
  | "tableName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = TEXT_MANUAL and type = TABLE; type: TABLE *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when tableName is set or tableName is set; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = TEXT_MANUAL and type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "oracleTextIndexColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = TEXT_MANUAL; type: TEXT *)
  | "searchIndexOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = TEXT_DBMS_SEARCH; type: OWNER *)
  | "searchIndexName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = TEXT_DBMS_SEARCH; type: TABLE *)
  | "searchSourceOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = TEXT_DBMS_SEARCH; type: OWNER *)
  | "searchSourceName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = TEXT_DBMS_SEARCH; type: TABLE *)
  | "jsonDualityView" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = DUALITY_VIEW; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "jsonSource" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = JSON_COLLECTION; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "optimizerHint" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when location in (LOCAL, REMOTE, WEB_SOURCE, DUALITY_VIEW, JSON_COLLECTION); type: TEXT *)
  | "searchableColumns" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* applies when type = SIMPLE; type: TEXT *)
  | "restSourceQueryFunction" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = SIMPLE and location = WEB_SOURCE; type: TEXT *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "tableView" | "sqlQuery" ) (* required; applies when type in (TEXT_MANUAL, VECTOR); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "tableOwner" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type = VECTOR and type = TABLE; type: OWNER *)
  | "tableName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = VECTOR and type = TABLE; type: TABLE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = VECTOR and type = SQL; type: SQL *)

title: search-config-data-profile-property
text:
<search-config-data-profile-property> ::= "nestedRows" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when restSource supports HAS_ARRAY_COLUMNS; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "nestedRows" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when jsonDualityView supports HAS_ARRAY_COLUMNS; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "nestedRows" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when jsonSource supports HAS_ARRAY_COLUMNS; type: COMPONENT *)

title: search-config-external-filter-property
text:
<search-config-external-filter-property> ::= "enabled" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when restSource is set; type: YES NO *)
  | "filter" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when enabled = Y; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: search-config-local-post-processing-property
text:
<search-config-local-post-processing-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "whereOrderByClause" | "sqlQuery" | "plsqlFunctionBody" ) (* applies when restSource is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "whereOrderByClause" | "sqlQuery" | "plsqlFunctionBody" ) (* applies when jsonDualityView is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> ( "whereOrderByClause" | "sqlQuery" | "plsqlFunctionBody" ) (* applies when jsonSource is set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "whereClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type = WHERE_ORDER_BY_CLAUSE; type: WHERE CLAUSE *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNC_BODY_RETURNING_SQL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY SQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY SQL *)

title: search-config-row-search-property
text:
<search-config-row-search-property> ::= "textQueryFunction" ":" <ws> ( "searchEngine" | "expertSearch" | "custom" ) (* applies when type in (TEXT_MANUAL, TEXT_DBMS_SEARCH); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "customFunctionName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (TEXT_MANUAL, TEXT_DBMS_SEARCH) and textQueryFunction = CUSTOM; type: TEXT *)

title: search-config-vector-attributes-property
text:
<search-config-vector-attributes-property> ::= "provider" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = VECTOR; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "columnName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = VECTOR; type: COLUMN *)
  | "searchType" ":" <ws> ( "exact" | "approx" ) (* required; applies when type = VECTOR; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "distanceMetric" ":" <ws> ( "cosine" | "dot" | "euclidean" | "euclideanSquared" | "hamming" | "manhattan" ) (* required; applies when type = VECTOR; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "targetAccuracy" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when type = VECTOR and searchType = APPROX; type: INTEGER *)

title: search-config-order-by-property
text: <search-config-order-by-property> ::= "orderByClause" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type != VECTOR; type: ORDER BY CLAUSE *)

title: search-config-column-mapping-property
text:
<search-config-column-mapping-property> ::= "primaryKey1Column" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: COLUMN *)
  | "primaryKey2Column" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)
  | "titleColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: COLUMN *)
  | "subtitleColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)
  | "descriptionColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)
  | "badgeColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)
  | "mimeTypeColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when imageColumn is set; type: COLUMN *)
  | "lastModifiedColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)
  | "customColumn1" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)
  | "customColumn2" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)
  | "customColumn3" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)
  | "scoreColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: COLUMN *)

title: search-config-link-property
text:
<search-config-link-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "redirectThisApp" | "redirectOtherApp" | "redirectUrl" | "redirectUrlReturnedByFirstCol" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "target" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when type = REDIRECT_PAGE; type: LINK_IN_APP *)
  | "target" ":" <ws> <value> (* required; applies when type = REDIRECT_APP; type: LINK_IN_DIFF_APP *)
  | "targetUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = REDIRECT_URL; type: TEXT *)

title: search-config-icon-and-badge-property
text:
<search-config-icon-and-badge-property> ::= "iconSource" ":" <ws> ( "initials" | "iconClass" | "iconClassColumn" | "imageUrl" | "imageBlobColumn" ) (* type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "iconColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when iconSource = DYNAMIC_CLASS; type: COLUMN *)
  | "imageColumn" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when iconSource = BLOB; type: COLUMN *)
  | "imageUrl" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when iconSource = URL; type: TEXT *)
  | "iconCssClasses" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when iconSource = STATIC_CLASS; type: ICON *)

title: search-config-appearance-property
text:
<search-config-appearance-property> ::= "cssClasses" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "maxVectorDistance" ":" <ws> <number> (* applies when type = VECTOR; type: INTEGER *)

title: search-config-server-side-condition-property
text:
<search-config-server-side-condition-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: SELECT LIST; large enum list omitted *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS); type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "page" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_EQUALS_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_EQUAL_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "pages" ":" <ws> <array-of-number> (* required; applies when type in (CURRENT_PAGE_IN_CONDITION, CURRENT_PAGE_NOT_IN_CONDITION); type: PAGE *)
  | "text" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST, VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_NOT_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST); type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (DISPLAY_COND_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_NOT_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_EQUAL_COND_TEXT, DISP_COND_NOT_EQUAL_COND_TEXT); type: TEXT *)

title: search-config-child-component
text:
<search-config-child-component> ::= <parameter-h>

(* parameter *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: parameter-h-value-property
text:
<parameter-h-value-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "staticValue" | "restSourceDefault" | "item" | "sqlQuery" | "expression" | "functionBody" | "collectionClob" | "preference" | "null" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = STATIC and name NOT_FEATURES BOOLEAN_PARAMETER; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> ( "true" | "false" ) (* required; applies when type = STATIC and name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL_QUERY; type: SQL *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = ITEM; type: ITEM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = PREFERENCE; type: TEXT *)
  | "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = COLLECTION; type: TEXT *)
  | "formatMask" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when name supports NUMBER_PARAMETER, DATE_PARAMETER, TIMESTAMP_PARAMETER, TIMESTAMP_TZ_PARAMETER and type in (STATIC, ITEM, PREFERENCE); type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "trueValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER and type in (ITEM, PREFERENCE); type: TEXT *)
  | "falseValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER and type in (ITEM, PREFERENCE); type: TEXT *)

(* shortcut *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: shortcut-source-property
text:

  | "agent" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when type supports AI_ENABLED_ALWAYS, AI_ENABLED and enabled = Y or not set; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "service" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when agent is not set; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "systemPrompt" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* applies when type supports AI_SYSTEM_PROMPT and agent is not set; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: activity-source-property
text:
<activity-source-property> ::= "location" ":" <ws> ( "localDatabase" | "restEnabledSql" ) (* required; applies when type = NATIVE_PLSQL; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when location = LOCAL; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlCode" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL *)
  | "javaScriptCode" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "remoteServer" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; applies when location = REMOTE; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "plsqlCode" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when location = REMOTE; type: PLSQL *)

title: activity-deadline-property
text:
<activity-deadline-property> ::= "dueOnType" ":" <ws> ( "interval" | "sqlQuery" | "expression" | "functionBody" | "schedulerExpression" ) (* applies when type != NATIVE_WORKFLOW_WAIT; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "interval" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when dueOnType = INTERVAL; type: TEXT *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when dueOnType = SQL_QUERY; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when dueOnType = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when dueOnType = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "schedulerExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when dueOnType = SCHEDULER_EXPRESSION; type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: activity-parallel-flow-property
text: <activity-parallel-flow-property> ::= "branch" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when type not in (NATIVE_PARALLEL_WF, NATIVE_WORKFLOW_START, NATIVE_WORKFLOW_END); type: COMPONENT *)

title: activity-advanced-property
text:
<activity-advanced-property> ::= "staticId" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: STATIC ID *)
  | "label" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: TEXT *)
  | "diagram" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* type: HIDDEN *)

title: activity-child-component
text:
<activity-child-component> ::= <activity-variable>
  | <branch-b>
  | <connection-a>
  | <connection-b>
  | <parameter-q>
  | <parameter-r>
  | <parameter-s>
  | <parameter-t>

(* activityVariable *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: activity-variable-value-property
text:
<activity-variable-value-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "staticValue" | "item" | "sqlQuery" | "expression" | "functionBody" | "null" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = STATIC and dataType != BOOLEAN; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> ( "true" | "false" ) (* required; applies when type = STATIC and dataType = BOOLEAN; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = ITEM; type: ITEM *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL_QUERY; type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)

title: activity-variable-display-format-masks-property
text:
<activity-variable-display-format-masks-property> ::= "sessionStateFormatMask" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when dataType in (NUMBER, TIMESTAMP, TIMESTAMP_TZ, TIMESTAMP_LTZ); type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "trueValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when dataType = BOOLEAN and type not in (STATIC); type: TEXT *)
  | "falseValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when dataType = BOOLEAN and type not in (STATIC); type: TEXT *)

title: activity-variable-comments-property
text:
<activity-variable-comments-property> ::= "comments" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)

text:
<branch-b-comments-property> ::= "comments" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)

title: connection-a-direct-property
text:
<connection-a-direct-property> ::= "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)

title: connection-a-execution-property
text: <connection-a-execution-property> ::= "sequence" ":" <ws> <number> (* applies when type = ERROR; type: NUMBER *)

title: connection-a-activity-property
text:
<connection-a-activity-property> ::= "from" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; type: COMPONENT *)
  | "to" ":" <ws> <reference> (* required; type: COMPONENT *)

title: connection-a-condition-property
text:
<connection-a-condition-property> ::= "operator" ":" <ws> ( "=" | "!=" | ">" | "<" | ">=" | "<=" | "isNotNull" ) (* required; applies when type = ERROR; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when operator != NOT_NULL; type: TEXT *)

title: connection-a-config-property
text: <connection-a-config-property> ::= "buildOption" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when type = ERROR; type: COMPONENT *)

title: connection-a-comments-property
text:
<connection-a-comments-property> ::= "comments" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)

(* connection *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: connection-b-execution-property
text: <connection-b-execution-property> ::= "sequence" ":" <ws> <number> (* required; applies when property != TRUE_FALSE_CHECK; type: NUMBER *)

title: connection-b-server-side-condition-property
text:
<connection-b-server-side-condition-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "rowsReturned" | "noRowsReturned" | "expression" | "functionBody" | "variable=value" | "variable!=value" | "variableIsNull" | "variableIsNotNull" | "variableIsZero" | "variableIsNotZero" | "variableIsNullOrZero" | "variableIsNotNullAndNotZero" | "variableContainsNoSpaces" | "variableIsNumeric" | "variableIsNotNumeric" | "variableIsAlphanumeric" | "variableIsInColonDelimitedList" | "variableIsNotInColonDelimitedList" | "textIsContainedInVariable" | "text=value" | "text!=value" | "textIsContainedInValue" | "textIsNotContainedInValue" | "never" ) (* applies when property = IF_ELSE; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type in (EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS); type: SQL *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION BOOLEAN *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY BOOLEAN *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "text" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: TEXT *)
  | "list" ":" <ws> <array-of-string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST, VALUE_OF_ITEM_IN_CONDITION_NOT_IN_COLON_DELIMITED_LIST); type: TEXT *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; type: ITEM *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type in (DISPLAY_COND_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_NOT_IN_COND_TEXT, DISPLAY_COND_EQUAL_COND_TEXT, DISP_COND_NOT_EQUAL_COND_TEXT); type: TEXT *)

title: connection-b-condition-property
text:
<connection-b-condition-property> ::= "when" ":" <ws> ( "true" | "false" | "null" ) (* required; applies when property = TRUE_FALSE_CHECK; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "operator" ":" <ws> ( "=" | "!=" | ">" | "<" | ">=" | "<=" | "isNotNull" | "isNull" | "otherwise" ) (* required; applies when property in (CHECK_WF_VARIABLE, CASE); type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "value" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when property in (CHECK_WF_VARIABLE, CASE) and operator not in (OTHERWISE, IS_NULL, NOT_NULL); type: TEXT *)

title: connection-b-config-property
text: <connection-b-config-property> ::= "buildOption" ":" <ws> <reference> (* applies when property = IF_ELSE; type: COMPONENT *)

title: connection-b-comments-property
text:
<connection-b-comments-property> ::= "comments" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)

(* parameter *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: parameter-q-value-property
text:
<parameter-q-value-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "staticValue" | "item" | "sqlQuery" | "expression" | "functionBody" | "preference" | "null" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = STATIC; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL_QUERY; type: SQL *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = ITEM; type: ITEM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = PREFERENCE; type: TEXT *)

(* parameter *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: parameter-r-direct-property
text:
<parameter-r-direct-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "parameter" | "functionResult" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = PARAMETER; type: TEXT *)

title: parameter-r-parameter-property
text:
<parameter-r-parameter-property> ::= "direction" ":" <ws> ( "in" | "out" | "inOut" ) (* required; applies when type = PARAMETER; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "dataType" ":" <ws> ( "varchar2" | "clob" | "number" | "plsqlInteger" | "boolean" | "date" | "timestamp" | "timestampWithLocalTimeZone" | "timestampWithTimeZone" | "intervalYearToMonth" | "intervalDayToSecond" | "blob" | "char" | "rowid" | "custom" ) (* required; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "dataTypeName" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when dataType = CUSTOM; type: TEXT *)
  | "hasDefault" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when direction = IN; type: YES NO *)
  | "ignoreOutput" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when direction in (IN_OUT, OUT) or not set and dataType not in (CUSTOM, BLOB); type: YES NO *)

title: parameter-r-value-property
text:
<parameter-r-value-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when direction in (IN, IN_OUT) and ignoreOutput = Y or not set; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = STATIC and dataType != BOOLEAN; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> ( "true" | "false" ) (* required; applies when type = STATIC and dataType = BOOLEAN; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL_QUERY; type: SQL *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = ITEM or ignoreOutput = N; type: ITEM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION and dataType != CUSTOM; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY and dataType != CUSTOM; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION and dataType = CUSTOM; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY and dataType = CUSTOM; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = PREFERENCE; type: TEXT *)
  | "formatMask" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when dataType in (NUMBER, DATE, TIMESTAMP, TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, TIMESTAMP WITH LOCAL TIME ZONE) and property matches; type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "trueValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when dataType = BOOLEAN and property matches; type: TEXT *)
  | "falseValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when dataType = BOOLEAN and property matches; type: TEXT *)

title: parameter-r-comments-property
text:
<parameter-r-comments-property> ::= "comments" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* type: TEXT EDITOR *)

(* parameter *)
(* direct properties use default group: identification *)

title: parameter-s-parameter-property
text: <parameter-s-parameter-property> ::= "ignoreOutput" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when name supports IN_OUT_PARAMETER, OUT_PARAMETER; type: YES NO *)

title: parameter-s-value-property
text:
<parameter-s-value-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when name supports IN_PARAMETER, IN_OUT_PARAMETER or ignoreOutput = N; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = STATIC and name NOT_FEATURES BOOLEAN_PARAMETER; type: TEXT EDITOR *)
  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> ( "true" | "false" ) (* required; applies when type = STATIC and name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL_QUERY; type: SQL *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = ITEM; type: ITEM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "sql" | "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = EXPRESSION; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "preference" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = PREFERENCE; type: TEXT *)
  | "name" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = COLLECTION; type: TEXT *)
  | "formatMask" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when name supports NUMBER_PARAMETER, DATE_PARAMETER, TIMESTAMP_PARAMETER, TIMESTAMP_TZ_PARAMETER and type in (STATIC, ITEM, PREFERENCE); type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "trueValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER and type in (ITEM, PREFERENCE); type: TEXT *)
  | "falseValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER and type in (ITEM, PREFERENCE); type: TEXT *)

(* parameter *)

title: parameter-t-parameter-property
text: <parameter-t-parameter-property> ::= "ignoreOutput" ":" <ws> <boolean> (* required; applies when name supports OUT_PARAMETER, IN_OUT_PARAMETER; type: YES NO *)

title: parameter-t-value-property
text:
<parameter-t-value-property> ::= "type" ":" <ws> ( "staticValue" | "item" | "sqlQuery" | "expression" | "functionBody" | "preference" | "default" | "null" ) (* required; applies when name supports IN_PARAMETER, IN_OUT_PARAMETER and ignoreOutput = Y or not set; type: SELECT LIST *)

  | "staticValue" ":" <ws> ( "true" | "false" ) (* required; applies when type = STATIC and name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER; type: SELECT LIST *)
  | "sqlQuery" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when type = SQL_QUERY; type: SQL *)
  | "item" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* required; applies when type = ITEM or ignoreOutput = N; type: ITEM *)

  | "sqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = SQL; type: SQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "plsqlExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptExpression" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT EXPRESSION CUSTOM *)
  | "language" ":" <ws> ( "plsql" | "javaScript-mle" ) (* required; applies when type = FUNCTION_BODY; type: CODE LANGUAGE *)
  | "plsqlFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = PLSQL; type: PLSQL FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "javaScriptFunctionBody" ":" <ws> <multiline-string> (* required; applies when language = JAVASCRIPT; type: MLE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION BODY CUSTOM *)
  | "formatMask" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when name supports NUMBER_PARAMETER, TIMESTAMP_PARAMETER, TIMESTAMP_TZ__PARAMETER, TIMESTAMP_LTZ__PARAMETER and type in (STATIC, ITEM); type: COMBOBOX *)
  | "trueValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (ITEM, PREFERENCE) and name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER; type: TEXT *)
  | "falseValue" ":" <ws> <string-like-value> (* applies when type in (ITEM, PREFERENCE) and name supports BOOLEAN_PARAMETER; type: TEXT *)

title: participant-b-comments-property
